job_description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world's manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that's you we would love to have you join us!

The SAFe **Product Manager,** Software leads the definition, prioritization, and execution of software and digital investments for an Agile Release Train (ART) in the **Power and Motion Business Portfolio** . You will be the primary connection between business strategy, customer and user needs, and software engineering execution, translating market opportunities and stakeholder requirements into actionable roadmaps, features, and release priorities. You will collaborate with commercial, product, architecture, engineering, quality, cybersecurity, and program leadership teams to guide investment decisions and ensure delivery of customer and business value.

You will report to the SAFe Team Lead and will work a hybrid schedule based in Pune, India.

  
  

### **Your Responsibilities:**

* Develop and own the feature backlog and roadmap for software development according to portfolio priorities
* Manage alignment between Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), software architecture, and the Agile Release Train feature backlog
* Work with business stakeholders, architects, and development teams to set implementation direction and balance priorities
* Coordinate with stakeholders outside the business segment on integration plans, dependencies, and release alignment with connected products and platforms
* Work with development teams to remove implementation barriers and coordinate resolution of technical, dependency, and delivery issues with the necessary stakeholders
* Guide the ART in achieving predictable, high-quality objectives by responding to issues, making timely decisions, and supporting release readiness
* Develop intuitive familiarity with the software portfolio, architecture, technology, R&D, customer workflows, and market factors to collaborate across technical and commercial teams
* Manage several simultaneous initiatives related to the effectiveness and flow of the Agile Release Train
* Support implementation of the global business unit product strategy and Annual Operating Plan
* Partner with Product Management to resolve complex internal and external customer problems with broad, long-term effects, responding with urgency and delivering cost-effective, high-quality solutions
  

  

### **The Essentials - You Will Have:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Relevant Field
* Willing to travel up to 10%
  

  

### **The Preferred - You Might Also Have:**

* Typically requires a minimum of 5 years of related experience
* In-depth knowledge of Agile methodologies and techniques, with experience supporting or leading an Agile Release Train
* Knowledge of industrial automation products and the software ecosystems that configure, connect, monitor, or support them
* Familiarity with Rockwell Automation software, variable frequency drive, or motion product portfolios is highly desired
* Ability to collaborate effectively across commercial, product management, software engineering, architecture, quality, and program teams
* Demonstrated success working within a global matrix environment to achieve multiple simultaneous goals
* Ability to communicate complex technical and business information clearly to multiple levels of stakeholders
* Understanding of business profit and loss responsibility
  

  

### **What We Offer:**

* Comprehensive mindfulness programmes with a premium membership to Calm
* Volunteer Paid Time Off for eligible employees
* Company volunteer and donation matching program
* Employee Assistance Program
* Personalized wellbeing programmes through OnTrack
* On-demand digital course library for professional development
* Other local benefits

At Rockwell Automation, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace.

#LI-Hybrid

#LI-HR1

  
  
  

Rockwell Automation’s hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

title: Product Manager
job_description:
Turn Pricing Into Perfect Matches

  

At Shaadi.com, we don’t just help people find love—we build products that make millions of journeys possible. We’re looking for a sharp, high-energy Product Manager to own our Pricing & Promotions pods, where every experiment, offer, and price point directly shapes growth, conversion, and revenue.
  
If you love decoding user behaviour, running high-impact experiments, and turning data into business wins, this role is your kind of match.

️What You’ll Own

* Own the product strategy, roadmap, and execution for pricing, promotions, offers, and monetisation initiatives across Shaadi.com.
* Design and launch pricing models, discounting strategies, subscription offers, and campaign-led promotions that drive conversions without compromising long-term value.
* Use analytics, A/B tests, and user research to identify opportunities, validate hypotheses, and measure impact on revenue, retention, and user experience.
* Partner closely with Tech, Design, Data, Marketing, Finance, and Business teams to ship initiatives end to end.
* Monitor key metrics—conversion, ARPU, revenue, uptake, churn, and margin—and translate insights into clear product decisions.
* Balance user delight with business outcomes: build offers that feel valuable to members while driving sustainable growth.

  

Who We’re Looking For

* 2–4 years of product management experience, ideally in pricing, promotions, growth, monetisation, or B2C product roles.
* Experience at a top consumer-facing organisation is strongly preferred—someone who understands scale, speed, and user-first thinking.
* MBA from a top B-school is preferred.
* High IQ, strong structured thinking, and the ability to simplify complex trade-offs quickly.
* Comfortable with data: funnels, cohorts, experiments, pricing elasticity, and business metrics.
* A builder’s mindset: proactive, ownership-driven, comfortable with ambiguity, and excited to ship fast.

Why Shaadi.com?

* Work on one of India’s most iconic consumer internet brands, with real impact on millions of users.
* Own high-visibility pricing and promotions pods where your decisions move the business.
* Be based in Mumbai, working onsite with product, tech, and business leaders.

title: Senior Product Manager - Mutual Funds
job_description:
Designation: NA

Location: India Maharashtra Thane - GCorp

Organization: Financial Services

**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Role Overview**
=================

We are looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to own and investment products with a strong focus on Mutual Funds. The role will drive product strategy, roadmap, customer journeys, integrations and business outcomes across mobile and web platforms. The ideal candidate will have hands-on product management experience in a digital investment platform, wealth-tech company, fintech, bank or broking environment, and a strong understanding of the mutual fund investment lifecycle.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**1. Mutual Fund Product Ownership**
------------------------------------

* Own the end-to-end mutual fund product lifecycle across discovery, investment, servicing and portfolio management.
* Drive digital journeys for onboarding, KYC, risk profiling, lumpsum investments, SIP registration, mandate setup, purchase, redemption, switch, cancellation, SIP pause/modify and transaction tracking.
* Build and enhance fund discovery, scheme details, comparison, filters, portfolio views, performance analytics, goal-based investing and investor education features.
* Work on integrations with AMCs, RTAs, BSE StAR MF / relevant transaction platforms, payment gateways, banks and other ecosystem partners, as applicable.
* Improve funnel conversion, transaction success, SIP activation, repeat investments, AUM growth and customer retention.
* Ensure a seamless experience across direct and regular mutual fund propositions, where applicable.

**2. Digital Product Strategy & Execution**
-------------------------------------------

* Define product vision, strategy, roadmap, prioritisation and success metrics in line with business objectives and customer needs.
* Translate business requirements into BRDs, product requirement documents, user stories, use cases, process flows and acceptance criteria.
* Drive product discovery through customer insights, data analysis, market research and competitor benchmarking.
* Partner with UX/UI, engineering, QA, operations, compliance and business teams to deliver scalable and intuitive digital experiences.
* Lead sprint planning, backlog prioritisation, UAT, release management and post-launch monitoring.

**3. Wealth & Investment Products**
-----------------------------------

* Work across adjacent investment products such as equities, ETFs, fixed deposits, bonds, NCDs, NPS, digital gold, PMS and AIFs, based on business priorities.
* Identify opportunities to create integrated investment journeys, cross-sell relevant products and improve customer lifetime value.
* Collaborate with AMCs, banks, brokers, fintech partners and vendors for product launches and platform integrations.

**4. Analytics & Business Growth**
----------------------------------

* Define and track KPIs including visitor-to-investor conversion, KYC completion, SIP registrations, mandate success, order success, AUM, active investors and repeat transaction rates.
* Analyse customer behaviour, funnel drop-offs, cohorts and product usage to identify growth and experience improvements.
* Use experimentation, A/B testing and data-led prioritisation to optimise product journeys.
* Prepare product performance dashboards and business reviews for senior stakeholders.

**5. Regulatory, Risk & Compliance**
------------------------------------

* Work with compliance, legal and operations teams to translate applicable SEBI, AMFI, AMCs, RTA and other regulatory requirements into product features and controls.
* Ensure appropriate disclosures, risk profiling, suitability, consent, audit trails and transaction controls are incorporated into customer journeys.
* Support regulatory change implementation, issue resolution and applicable reporting requirements.

**Required Experience & Skills**
================================

* 10–14 years of overall experience, with substantial hands-on product management experience in mutual funds or digital investment platforms.
* Strong understanding of the mutual fund lifecycle, including onboarding/KYC, fund discovery, purchase, SIP, mandates, redemption, switch, portfolio tracking and servicing.
* Experience owning digital products on mobile apps and/or web platforms, preferably in a high-volume consumer fintech or wealth-tech environment.
* Ability to define product strategy, write clear requirements, prioritise roadmaps and deliver measurable business outcomes.
* Experience working with engineering, design, QA, operations, compliance, business teams and external technology partners.
* Strong product analytics, funnel analysis, problem-solving, stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Working knowledge of APIs, payment flows, integrations, Agile delivery and UAT.

**Preferred Company Background**
================================

Candidates from digital investment, wealth-tech, fintech, discount broking and online mutual fund platforms will be strongly preferred. Relevant target organisations may include:

* Groww
* Zerodha (especially Coin / mutual fund product teams)
* ET Money
* INDmoney
* Kuvera
* Paytm Money
* Upstox
* Angel One
* FundsIndia
* Scripbox
* Other comparable digital wealth or mutual fund investment platforms.

Important: Prior experience in one of the above companies is a sourcing preference, not a substitute for relevant product ownership. Candidates must have directly worked on mutual fund product features, journeys or platform enhancements. Experience limited to sales, relationship management, distribution or back-office operations without digital product ownership would not be sufficient for this role.

**Educational Qualifications**
==============================

* MBA / PGDM / MFM or postgraduate qualification in Finance, Management, Technology or a related discipline preferred.
* NISM or other relevant capital markets / mutual fund certifications will be an advantage.

**Key Performance Indicators**
==============================

* Growth in mutual fund investors, AUM and SIP registrations.
* Improvement in onboarding, KYC, mandate and transaction conversion rates.
* Order success rate, journey completion and reduction in customer drop-offs.
* Feature adoption, active usage, repeat investments and customer retention.
* On-time delivery of roadmap commitments and quality of product releases.
* Regulatory readiness and timely implementation of compliance requirements.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Lead Digital Product Manager
job_description:
**About this role:**

Wells Fargo is seeking a Lead Digital Product Manager.

This role sits at the core of CIB’s AI transformation agenda, shaping the roadmap, governance, implementation, and scaling of next‑generation AI/GenAI capabilities across business lines. You will drive strategic assessments, integrate AI solutions into key workflows, ensure risk‑aligned delivery, and partner closely with senior leadership to execute high‑impact innovation initiatives.

**In this role, you will:**

* Lead the development and execution of complex digital business plans, programs and initiatives which have impact across the enterprise with broad impact
* Act as key participant in large-scale planning
* Review and analyze complex digital strategy for product/functionality/experience area
* Influence digital strategy for the business line requiring in-depth evaluation of multiple factors including intangibles or unprecedented factors
* Make decisions in digital strategy for product/functionality/experience area requiring strong understanding of the business, policies, procedures and/or compliance requirements
* Lead a broad team of digital professionals to meet deliverables and drive new initiatives
* Strategically collaborate and consult with peers, colleagues and mid-level to senior managers to resolve issues and achieve goals
* Potentially lead projects, teams or serve as a peer mentor

**Required Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of digital product management experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

**Desired Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of experience in **transformation, product management, business analysis, business execution, and AI solution delivery**
* Deep knowledge of **Corporate & Investment Banking** products, workflows, and asset classes.
* Hands-on experience in **AI/GenAI** solution development and enterprise implementation.
* Strong proficiency with modern AI stacks (Lang Chain, Lang Graph, MCP), GenAI lifecycle processes, and model optimization techniques.
* Experience with **agentic AI**, workflow automation, document intelligence, and intelligent routing.
* Ability to operate across complex organizational structures with excellent communication and stakeholder‑management skills.
* Proven leadership experience, including team guidance, decision‑making, and strategic problem‑solving. Skilled in defining target‑state blueprints and actionable roadmaps.

**Job Expectations**

Ability to manage multiple high‑complexity initiatives with significant cross‑functional impact. Strong analytical, communication, and documentation skills (JIRA, Confluence).Comfortable driving change and influencing senior stakeholders in a dynamic, evolving transformation environment.

**AI & Innovation Delivery**

Lead and execute AI/GenAI initiatives aligned with CIB strategic priorities, from idea validation to deployment. Integrate AI solutions across key CIB journeys—Client, Vendor, Market, Lending—to improve efficiency, decisioning, and servicing experiences.

**Strategy, Governance & Execution**

Conduct strategic reviews, evaluate performance, and solve complex business challenges with structured frameworks and creative problem‑solving. Define and implement processes, procedures, success metrics, and lifecycle standards for AI/ML and agentic workflows.Ensure compliance with CIB and enterprise methodologies, AI governance, AIRR controls, and risk frameworks.

**Program & Stakeholder Leadership**

Lead end‑to‑end program management for high‑visibility innovation initiatives, including scope definition, execution planning, resource management, and stakeholder alignment. Collaborate with cross‑functional leaders across Technology, Product, Business Execution, Risk, and Data to drive delivery and manage dependencies.Mentor and guide junior staff across Strategy & Execution and Innovation teams.

**AI Architecture & Technical Understanding**

Apply practical understanding of LLM workflows, chunking, RAG, hallucination mitigation, vectorization, and prompt engineering. Utilize modern AI tooling (LangChain, LangGraph, Model Context Protocol) to support scalable, context-aware AI solutions. Partner with technical teams on cloud, data, integration design, document intelligence, and agentic orchestration.

**Posting End Date:**

19 Nov 2026

* ***Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.***

**We Value Equal Opportunity**

Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit’s risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements.

Candidates applying to job openings posted in Canada: Applications for employment are encouraged from all qualified candidates, including women, persons with disabilities, aboriginal peoples and visible minorities. Accommodation for applicants with disabilities is available upon request in connection with the recruitment process.

**Applicants with Disabilities**

To request a medical accommodation during the application or interview process, visit Disability Inclusion at Wells Fargo.

**Drug and Alcohol Policy**

Wells Fargo maintains a drug free workplace. Please see our Drug and Alcohol Policy to learn more.

**Wells Fargo Recruitment and Hiring Requirements:**

a. Third-Party recordings are prohibited unless authorized by Wells Fargo.

b. Wells Fargo requires you to directly represent your own experiences during the recruiting and hiring process.

c. Please be prepared to provide accurate information and supporting documentation in connection with any lawful employment and education verification conducted by Wells Fargo.

title: Principal Technical Product Manager, Agentic AI Platform
job_description:
**Position Type :**

Full time

**Type Of Hire :**

Experienced (relevant combo of work and education)

**Principal Technical Product Manager, Agentic AI Platform**

**Location:** Bangalore, India
  
**Function:** Enterprise AI & Data Platforms

**About the Role:**

We are looking for a **Principal Technical Product Manager** to drive the **enablement and enterprise adoption of our Agentic AI Platform**.

You will own the end-to-end experience that enables engineering teams to **discover, onboard, build, migrate and run AI applications and agents at scale**. Working across Platform Engineering, Architecture, Security and product teams, you will translate developer needs and adoption barriers into scalable platform capabilities.

**Your mission: Make our Agentic AI Platform the easiest, safest and most reliable way to build and operate AI across the enterprise.**

**What You'll Do**

* Own the **platform adoption strategy and developer experience**, from onboarding through production.
* Create simple, self-service **onboarding, migration and developer journeys**.
* Partner with engineering teams to identify adoption blockers and convert them into prioritized platform capabilities.
* Shape the roadmap across **AI Gateway, agent frameworks, MCP, model services, identity, APIs/SDKs, observability and deployment**.
* Drive migration of existing AI workloads onto common enterprise platform capabilities.
* Establish clear **production-readiness, reliability, support and operational standards**.
* Use platform telemetry and developer feedback to measure adoption and continuously improve the experience.
* Embed **security, risk and responsible-AI controls** into reusable platform patterns.

**What We're Looking For**

* **15+ years** in technical product management, platform product management or comparable technology leadership.
* Experience scaling a **developer, cloud, API, ML or AI platform** to enterprise adoption.
* Strong technical understanding of **LLMs, agentic AI, MCP, APIs/SDKs, Kubernetes, cloud, identity, RAG, observability and CI/CD**.
* Experience with ecosystems such as **Azure AI/Azure OpenAI, AWS, GitHub, Anthropic Claude** or similar technologies.
* Ability to work deeply with engineers and architects while translating technical complexity into clear product priorities.
* Proven ability to drive outcomes across multiple engineering and business organizations.

**The impact you’ll make**

As Principal Technical Product Manager, you will help teams onboard faster, use more self-service capabilities and move more AI solutions into production. Your work will remove developer blockers, improve platform reliability and increase the reuse of common capabilities. You will turn solutions for individual teams into scalable platform features that benefit teams across the enterprise.

**What we offer you**

Ready to build what's next? At FIS, you'll have the opportunity to grow your career, contribute your ideas, and help create technology that powers the global economy.

Our benefits include:

* Opportunities to innovate in fintech
* Tools for personal and professional growth
* Internal career growth opportunities
* Inclusive and diverse work environment
* Resources to invest in your community

**Privacy Statement**

FIS is committed to protecting the privacy and security of all personal information that we process in order to provide services to our clients. For specific information on how FIS protects personal information online, please see the Online Privacy Notice.

**Sourcing Model**

Recruitment at FIS works primarily on a direct sourcing model; a relatively small portion of our hiring is through recruitment agencies. FIS does not accept resumes from recruitment agencies which are not on the preferred supplier list and is not responsible for any related fees for resumes submitted to job postings, our employees, or any other part of our company.

title: Product Manager - Power Electronics
job_description:
Required Experience, minimum: 7 years

  

Required Experience, maximum: 13 years

  

* Skills: Power Electronics, Power Converters, Renewable Energy

  

* Minimum Qualification: Bachelor of Technology (BTech), Master of Technology (MTech)

  

**Job Description: Power Electronics Product Manager**

**Location: Bangalore**

The Power Electronics Product Manager is responsible for defining, developing, and driving the roadmap for power-electronics-based products such as AC-DC converters, DC-DC converters, EV chargers, inverters, and energy storage systems. The role involves deep technical understanding, market analysis, and coordination across R&D, manufacturing, supply chain, marketing, and sales to ensure successful product launches and lifecycle management.

Key Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Roadmap

* Define product vision, roadmap, and value proposition for power-electronics products.
* Identify technology trends
* Conduct market sizing, competitive benchmarking, and application analysis.
* Prioritize product requirements based on customer needs, cost targets, and ROI.

Product Development & Engineering Interface

* Convert customer requirements into Product Requirement Documents (PRD).
* Work closely with R&D teams (hardware, firmware, mechanical, testing) to guide design decisions.
* Drive feature prioritization and ensure alignment with timelines.
* Review electrical design concepts (topologies, switching methods, thermal design).
* Ensure compliance with relevant standards (IEC, UL, BIS, AIS, ISO).

Product Launch

* Plan and execute go-to-market strategy.
* Prepare technical datasheets, product manuals, and certification documentation.
* Conduct internal training for sales, service, and channel partners.
* Drive pilot trials, field validation, and customer feedback loops.

Product Lifecycle Management

* Monitor product performance, cost, quality, and reliability.
* Coordinate cost-down initiatives with SCM and Engineering.
* Manage component EOL (End of Life) transitions.
* Drive continuous improvement and next-gen platform development.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Work with supply chain and procurement to ensure component availability
* Align with operations for manufacturability, testing, and yield improvements.
* Support marketing with technical content, brochures, and application notes.
* Support sales in key customer visits and RFQ responses.

Customer & Market Interaction

* Collect VOC (Voice of Customer) and translate into technical features.
* Work with OEMs/Integrators for customisations.
* Identify application-specific opportunities (solar, EV, ESS, industrial, telecom, rail, defence).

Required Skills & Qualifications

Technical Skills

* Strong understanding of power electronics topologies
* Knowledge of IGBT, SiC/GaN device selection, magnetics design, thermal design.
* Familiarity with digital control platforms (DSPs, microcontrollers, FPGA basics).
* Understanding of EMI/EMC requirements and testing.
Experience with converter/inverter hardware lifecycle.  

  

Business & Product Skills

* Experience in building product roadmaps and managing product lifecycles.
* Ability to translate technical concepts into business outcomes.
* Strong analytical skills for pricing, costing, and market studies.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication.  

  

Qualifications

* B.Tech / M.Tech in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, or related field.
* 5–12 years of experience in R&D, Applications Engineering, or Product Management in a power-electronics domain, preferably from relevant industries.

Preferred Experience

* Should have handled Power Electronics Products like EV Charger, PV /PCS Central/String Inverter, AC-DC/DC-DC converters, Drives.
* Familiarity with Product certification (IEC/UL) & Testing
* Exposure High Power System 50 KW to 5 MW
* Knowledge of PLM tools and project management tools.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
**About the Team**

Product Management in Meesho closely resembles our rocketship growth. Because we obsess over understanding customer behaviour, we’ve been able to carve out an e-commerce niche in Tier 2/3/4 towns in Bharat. Our business growth is testimony to a singular focus on how we think of ‘product’ for our unique customers - ones that have barely shopped online, but are now able to because of Meesho.

Fun fact: Nearly 7% of India’s households shop with us.

We are driven by a ‘user-first’ mindset. We have a strong bias for action. Above all, our team is driven by impact, not features. We drive ‘problem discovery’ & delivery - not only obsess over “what to build”, but execute with rigour to create impact.

But there’s more – we love to have fun as much as we love to work hard. From movie buffs, to sportspersons, we have a super cool team. So, if a game of badminton after a day of brainstorming at work sounds like something you would love to do, then join us!

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager who is passionate about solving high impact problems in a fast paced start-up environment with a high degree of autonomy. This is inherently a cross-functional leadership role where you will work closely with teams such as software engineering, UX design, category mgmt., marketing, operations, finance, etc to bring a new product to life.

### **What will you do**

* Market & Customer Understanding: Understand the e-commerce market and needs of customers/sellers deeply through landscape analysis, customer interviews, user research, competition analysis and other qualitative/quantitative techniques.
* Problem Identification & Prioritization: Adopt a structured approach to identify what problems need to be solved and break them down into smaller chunks. Prioritize what problems need to be solved now vs. later.
* Solution Discovery: Facilitate a process to come up with the best technology-led ideas to solve the prioritized problems. Harness the creativity of not just yourself but of other teams such as design, engg., business, etc. Be willing to experiment with multiple solution ideas and test them using MVPs, prototypes, etc.
* Product Delivery: Define detailed product requirements and work collaboratively with a cross-functional team (design, engineering, business, analytics, etc.) to bring a product to life. Ensure high product quality through processes such as user acceptance testing, dogfooding, etc.
* Go-to-Market Planning: Create a go-to-market plan working with business/marketing stakeholders to maximize product adoption and success.
* Adoption & Metrics: Define product metrics for your area, and track them continuously. Identify usage patterns and come up with action plans to move metrics in the right direction.
* Roadmap Creation: Create a product roadmap for your area that has at least a 3-month forward looking view of key customer/business problems to be solved.
* Team Leadership: Manage a small team of product analysts and associate product managers, and guide them towards product execution.

### **What you will need**

* Overall experience of 7+ yrs with atleast 5+ yrs in product management in a tech-led company (consumer internet space is preferred)
* Exceptional problem solving skills based on first principles thinking
* Good understanding of technology, and comfort with product management processes such as A/B experimentation, writing product requirement documents, managing product backlogs, and creating roadmaps

### **About us**

Welcome to Meesho, where every story begins with a spark of inspiration and a dash of entrepreneurial spirit. We're not just a platform; we're your partner in turning dreams into realities.

**Curious about life at Meesho? Explore our Glassdoor - our people have a lot to say and they've helped us become a loved workplace in India.**

### **Our Mission**

Democratising internet commerce for everyone — Meesho (Meri Shop) started with a single idea in mind: to be an e-commerce destination for Indian consumers and to enable small businesses to succeed online.

job_description:
**About Tekion:**
-----------------

Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.

**About Tekion**  
  
Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform. Our platform spans the Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, the Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises, and the Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform, using cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to bring together vehicle manufacturers, dealerships, and consumers. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia, and Europe.
  
  
**About the Role**
  
  
Tekion connects dealerships - the businesses that sell and service vehicles - with the automakers that build those vehicles, such as General Motors, Honda, or Ford. Across the industry these automakers are referred to as OEMs (Original Equipment Manufacturers). The software on each side needs to exchange information automatically and reliably: vehicle orders, inventory, repair records, customer details, and much more. The software that makes this exchange happen is called integration. We are seeking a driven, technically curious Product Manager I to join our Integrations team. You will take ownership of one integration pattern - a family of similar integrations that share the same shape (for example, all the integrations that send vehicle service and repair data to automakers). Your mission is to make every integration in that family measurably healthy and best-in-class, shift more of its delivery from manual building to AI-assisted building, and make sure dealerships actually adopt and benefit from it. This is a hands-on role for an early-career product manager who is comfortable with technical concepts, motivated by measurable outcomes, and excited to help modernize how a decades-old industry connects its software. You will work closely with Engineering, Design, and senior product managers, who will guide and mentor you as you grow into full ownership of your integration pattern.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
  
  

* Keep your integrations healthy and best-in-class: Define what “good” looks like for your integration pattern, measure it in our Integration Platform (Tekion’s internal health-monitoring system), and drive coverage, reliability, and quality up across all your integrations - benchmarking each against the best competing product in the market.

  

* Win on AI-powered delivery: Shift your pattern from hand-built integrations toward ones generated with Tekion’s AI-assisted build tools (internally, APC Studio), help sharpen the AI tools you depend on, and own a complete, living set of requirements that any engineering team can build from.

  

* Drive revenue through OEM certifications: Lead integration patterns toward successful OEM certification so OEM-approved integrations can be adopted by dealers at scale. Drive adoption and reduce support load: Make your integrations easy to install and switch on, raise dealership uptake where it is low, and reduce support tickets by tracking and fixing root causes.

  

* Partner across teams: Translate the needs of dealers, automakers, and partners into clear requirements, and work day-to-day with Engineering, Design, Support, and Go-to-Market teams to deliver, launch, and measure impact.

  
**What We’re Looking For**
  
  

* Around 3+ years of product management experience, or equivalent experience in a technical product, integration, API, or platform role. Strong early-career candidates with a technical background are encouraged to apply.

  

* Exposure to integrations, APIs, or platform and marketplace products, with the ability to read technical documentation and discuss APIs, webhooks, and data flows with engineers. (An API is a defined way for two systems to exchange data; a webhook is an automatic notification one system sends another when something happens. You do not need to write code.)

  

* A strong bias toward measurable outcomes, with comfort using dashboards, metrics, and data to set targets and track progress.

  
• Clear writing skills - the ability to turn messy, ambiguous requirements into crisp specifications and user stories. • Curiosity about AI and how it can automate technical work, plus the drive to improve the tools you use.
  
  

* Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work with both technical and non-technical audiences.

  

* The ability to manage ambiguity, prioritize effectively, and make thoughtful trade-offs in a fast-paced environment.

  

* A bachelor’s degree in business, computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  
**Nice to Have**
  
  

* Interest in or exposure to AI agents, large language models (LLMs), and automated workflows.

  

* Familiarity with the automotive retail world - dealerships, the Dealer Management System (DMS, the core software a dealership runs its business on), or automaker (OEM) certification programs.

  
**Why Join Us**  
  

* Modernize an industry: Help modernize how an entire industry connects its software, moving from slow, hand-built integrations to a fast, AI-powered delivery model.

  

* Work at the frontier of AI delivery: Be hands-on with how AI is used to scope, build, and test real enterprise integrations.

  

* See measurable impact: Own clear, measurable goals and watch your work show up directly in integration health, adoption, and support metrics.

  

* Grow with mentorship: Learn from senior product managers and engineers, with a clear path to grow into broader ownership.

  
Tekion is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

**Current Tekion Employees: Please apply via the Internal Job Board in Ashby.**

Note: Tekion recently transitioned to a new recruiting tool and we appreciate your patience and feedback as we adjust to our new system!

Tekion is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, victim of violence or having a family member who is a victim of violence, the intersectionality of two or more protected categories, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

For more information on our privacy practices, please refer to our Applicant Privacy Notice

***Important****: Tekion will only contact candidates from an @**tekion.com* *email address or through our applicant tracking system (no-reply@ashbyhq.com). We may also work with authorized recruiting partners from time to time. Tekion and its recruiting partners will never ask you to pay fees or send money for applications, interviews, training, or onboarding. If you receive a message that seems suspicious, please do not respond or share personal or financial information.*

### **Why Work at Lenovo**

We are Lenovo. We do what we say. We own what we do. We WOW our customers.

  
  

Lenovo is a US$83 billion revenue global technology powerhouse, ranked #153 in the Fortune Global 500, and serving millions of customers every day in 180 markets. Focused on a bold vision to deliver Smarter Technology for All, Lenovo has built on its success as the world’s largest PC company with a full-stack portfolio of AI-enabled, AI-ready, and AI-optimized devices (PCs, workstations, smartphones, tablets), infrastructure (server, storage, edge, high performance computing and software defined infrastructure), software, solutions, and services. Lenovo’s continued investment in world-changing innovation is building a more equitable, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. Lenovo is listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange under Lenovo Group Limited (HKSE: 992) (ADR: LNVGY).

  

This transformation together with Lenovo’s world-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit www.lenovo.com, and read about the latest news via our StoryHub.

### **Description and Requirements**

**Product Strategy & Vision**

* Define and own the global product vision and strategy for Offer-to-Glass.
* Translate Digital Commerce strategy and OGSM priorities into an outcome-based product roadmap.
* Establish a clear definition of what constitutes a complete, accurate, sellable, and customer-ready offer.
* Balance near-term commercial requirements with global scalability, simplification, automation, and longer-term platform capabilities.

**Offer Readiness & Digital Shelf**

* Own the product capabilities required to move approved offers onto the digital shelf.
* Ensure product information, attributes, taxonomy, digital assets, localized content, pricing, promotions, and availability information can be accurately represented in the customer experience.
* Identify breakdowns between source systems and what customers ultimately see on Lenovo.com.
* Establish monitoring and measures that assess the actual customer-facing offer rather than relying solely on upstream system status.

**Roadmap, Prioritization & Investment**

* Maintain a single, prioritized roadmap and backlog for Offer-to-Glass.
* Bring Geo and business-unit demand into the product model rather than managing requests as disconnected local projects.
* Prioritize according to customer value, business impact, strategic alignment, evidence, dependencies, risk, and effort.
* Make clear trade-offs when demand exceeds available capacity or funding.

**Product Discovery**

* Lead continuous discovery to understand why products and offers become delayed, incomplete, inaccurate, incorrectly priced, unavailable, or otherwise unsellable.
* Use customer research, analytics, operational data, business feedback, and experimentation to validate problems before committing significant investment.
* Define problem statements, hypotheses, expected outcomes, and success measures before moving into delivery.

**Delivery, Launch & Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain product accountability from discovery through delivery, launch, adoption, measurement, and improvement.
* Partner with Technology and Engineering on scope, sequencing, release, and technical dependencies while retaining accountability for the product outcome.
* Ensure capabilities are adopted across markets and transition appropriate steady-state processes to operational teams.
* Monitor production performance and place corrective work back into the roadmap when offers are wrong, missing, or unsellable.

**Global & Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Align Digital Commerce, Geo commerce teams, merchandising, pricing, Product, Design, Technology, Engineering, Analytics, Operations, and business units around shared outcomes.
* Establish clear decision rights and handoffs with adjacent product domains.
* Communicate strategy, priorities, investment needs, progress, risks, decisions, and outcomes to senior leadership.
* Lead through influence within a global, highly matrixed organization.

The Senior Product Manager should establish baselines and targets covering:

* Accuracy of products, prices, promotions, and offer information on Lenovo.com
* Percentage of intended assortment that is live and sellable
* Time from approved offer or price change to customer visibility
* Product/content/data completeness
* Accuracy of availability and delivery signals
* Reduction in offers that are missing, incorrect, or unsellable
* Production regressions affecting live offers
* Time to detect and resolve offer-related issues
* Global adoption of capabilities versus market-specific duplication
* Commercial impact attributable to improved offer readiness and merchandising capabilities

**Additional Locations**:

* India - Karnātaka - Bangalore

* India - Karnātaka - BANGALORE

* India

* India - Karnātaka

\* India - Karnātaka - Bangalore , \* India - Karnātaka - BANGALORE

**NOTICE FOR PUBLIC**

  

At Lenovo, we follow strict policies and legal compliance for our recruitment process, which includes role alignment, employment terms discussion, final selection and offer approval, and recording transactions in our internal system. Interviews may be conducted via audio, video, or in-person depending on the role, and you will always meet with an official Lenovo representative.

Please beware of fraudulent recruiters posing as Lenovo representatives. They may request cash deposits or personal information. Always apply through official Lenovo channels and never share sensitive information. Lenovo does not solicit money or sensitive information from applicants and will not request payments for training or equipment.

Kindly verify job offers through the official Lenovo careers page or contact IndiaTA@lenovo.com. Stay informed and cautious to protect yourself from recruitment fraud. Report any suspicious activity to local authorities.

We are Lenovo. We do what we say. We own what we do. We WOW our customers.

  
  

Lenovo is a US$83 billion revenue global technology powerhouse, ranked #153 in the Fortune Global 500, and serving millions of customers every day in 180 markets. Focused on a bold vision to deliver Smarter Technology for All, Lenovo has built on its success as the world’s largest PC company with a full-stack portfolio of AI-enabled, AI-ready, and AI-optimized devices (PCs, workstations, smartphones, tablets), infrastructure (server, storage, edge, high performance computing and software defined infrastructure), software, solutions, and services. Lenovo’s continued investment in world-changing innovation is building a more equitable, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. Lenovo is listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange under Lenovo Group Limited (HKSE: 992) (ADR: LNVGY).

  

This transformation together with Lenovo’s world-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit www.lenovo.com, and read about the latest news via our StoryHub.

### **Description and Requirements**

**Product Strategy & Vision**

* Define and own the global product vision and strategy for Offer-to-Glass.
* Translate Digital Commerce strategy and OGSM priorities into an outcome-based product roadmap.
* Establish a clear definition of what constitutes a complete, accurate, sellable, and customer-ready offer.
* Balance near-term commercial requirements with global scalability, simplification, automation, and longer-term platform capabilities.

**Offer Readiness & Digital Shelf**

* Own the product capabilities required to move approved offers onto the digital shelf.
* Ensure product information, attributes, taxonomy, digital assets, localized content, pricing, promotions, and availability information can be accurately represented in the customer experience.
* Identify breakdowns between source systems and what customers ultimately see on Lenovo.com.
* Establish monitoring and measures that assess the actual customer-facing offer rather than relying solely on upstream system status.

**Roadmap, Prioritization & Investment**

* Maintain a single, prioritized roadmap and backlog for Offer-to-Glass.
* Bring Geo and business-unit demand into the product model rather than managing requests as disconnected local projects.
* Prioritize according to customer value, business impact, strategic alignment, evidence, dependencies, risk, and effort.
* Make clear trade-offs when demand exceeds available capacity or funding.

**Product Discovery**

* Lead continuous discovery to understand why products and offers become delayed, incomplete, inaccurate, incorrectly priced, unavailable, or otherwise unsellable.
* Use customer research, analytics, operational data, business feedback, and experimentation to validate problems before committing significant investment.
* Define problem statements, hypotheses, expected outcomes, and success measures before moving into delivery.

**Delivery, Launch & Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain product accountability from discovery through delivery, launch, adoption, measurement, and improvement.
* Partner with Technology and Engineering on scope, sequencing, release, and technical dependencies while retaining accountability for the product outcome.
* Ensure capabilities are adopted across markets and transition appropriate steady-state processes to operational teams.
* Monitor production performance and place corrective work back into the roadmap when offers are wrong, missing, or unsellable.

**Global & Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Align Digital Commerce, Geo commerce teams, merchandising, pricing, Product, Design, Technology, Engineering, Analytics, Operations, and business units around shared outcomes.
* Establish clear decision rights and handoffs with adjacent product domains.
* Communicate strategy, priorities, investment needs, progress, risks, decisions, and outcomes to senior leadership.
* Lead through influence within a global, highly matrixed organization.

The Senior Product Manager should establish baselines and targets covering:

* Accuracy of products, prices, promotions, and offer information on Lenovo.com
* Percentage of intended assortment that is live and sellable
* Time from approved offer or price change to customer visibility
* Product/content/data completeness
* Accuracy of availability and delivery signals
* Reduction in offers that are missing, incorrect, or unsellable
* Production regressions affecting live offers
* Time to detect and resolve offer-related issues
* Global adoption of capabilities versus market-specific duplication
* Commercial impact attributable to improved offer readiness and merchandising capabilities

Senior Product Manager, 1

**Job Description**

**Mandatory Skills**  

* Regularly review reports specific to your domains in order to monitor health, revenue, and other important KPIs.

* You think at scale and have experience launching products in new areas with ambiguity.
* Product experience with web applications/SPAs; native app experience is a nice to have
* You have sound business judgment, proven ability to influence others, and strong analytical skills.
* You possess a passion for figuring out user problems, are able to work iteratively, and have a bias for action.

* You have experience with data driven product development and possess a knowledge of agile methodologies.
* You can tell stories through data.
* You know how to talk to users and extract meaningful insights through best practice research methods.

job_description:
**Product Manager – Life Sciences**

**Company:** Ross Biotech Private Limited  
**Location:** Bengaluru  
**Job Type:** Full-time  
**Experience:** 4–8 Years

**Job Description:**

Ross Biotech is looking for a dynamic and technically strong Product Manager / Application Manager to manage our Life Science and Scientific Instrumentation product portfolio.

The candidate will be responsible for product management, customer mapping, lead identification, lead qualification, application support, and coordination with international principals to develop business opportunities and expand market presence.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Manage assigned product portfolios and develop product-wise business strategies.
* Identify and map potential customers in the genomics, proteomics, immunology, cell biology, bioassay or related research areas.
* Generate new business leads and qualify opportunities based on customer requirements.
* Understand customer applications and recommend suitable products and solutions.
* Conduct product presentations, demonstrations, and technical discussions.
* Coordinate with customers and sales teams for product evaluations and business development.
* Manage relationships and regular communication with international principals.
* Coordinate with principals for product training, technical support, and new product launches.
* Monitor competitor activities, market trends, and new business opportunities.
* Support the sales team in technical discussions and opportunity conversion.
* Prepare monthly business reports, lead reports, and product performance updates.
* Report directly to the Director and achieve assigned KPIs.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* New customer identification and customer mapping.
* Qualified lead generation and opportunity development.
* Product-wise business pipeline development.
* Product presentations and customer demonstrations.
* Principal coordination and relationship management.
* Application support and customer satisfaction.
* Contribution towards business growth and revenue targets.
* Timely submission of monthly performance reports.

**Qualifications & Skills:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in biotechnology, Life Sciences, Biochemistry, Microbiology, or a related field.
* 4–8 years of experience in Product Management, Application Management, or Scientific Instrumentation.
* Strong account management and business development skills in liquid handling workflows, extraction reagents, biobanking.
* Good knowledge of life science products and laboratory applications.
* Experience in customer mapping, lead generation, and business development.
* Strong technical presentation and communication skills.
* Experience coordinating with international principals will be an added advantage.
* Good knowledge of MS Office and Excel.
* Willingness to travel for customer visits and business development activities.

**Interested Candidates**

Please share your updated resume at:

**hr@rossbiotech.com**

Join Ross Biotech and be part of our growing team in the Life Sciences and Biopharmaceutical industry!

title: Product Manager – Keysight EDA Solutions (S)
job_description:
We are looking for a technically competent and business-oriented Keysight EDA Product Manager responsible for driving sales growth, market development, product positioning, and customer engagement for Keysight Electronic Design Automation solutions.

The role involves identifying new business opportunities, developing strategic accounts, working closely with Keysight OEM teams, supporting technical sales activities, and achieving revenue targets across key industries.

  

**Key Roles & Responsibilities**

* **Product Management & Business Development**

* Drive sales and revenue growth for Keysight EDA solutions.
* Develop annual business plans, revenue targets, and product growth strategies.
* Identify new customers and emerging markets for RF, microwave, wireless, and semiconductor design solutions.
* Build and manage sales pipelines and forecast opportunities.
* Identify competitive replacement opportunities involving Cadence, Ansys, and other EDA solutions.
  

* **Sales & Key Account Management**

* Develop relationships with R&D heads, RF design engineers, technical directors, and engineering leadership.
* Manage strategic accounts across defence, aerospace, space, telecommunications, semiconductor, automotive, and research organizations.
* Conduct customer meetings, product presentations, and solution discussions.
* Work with application engineers to arrange product demonstrations, evaluations, and proof-of-concept activities.
  

* **OEM Coordination & Business Planning**

* Work closely with Keysight product and regional teams.
* Conduct business planning meetings.
* Coordinate technical support, customer evaluations, and product training.
* Prepare quarterly business reviews and account development plans.
* Identify opportunities for joint customer visits and marketing initiatives.
  

* **Marketing & Demand Generation**

* Organize technical workshops, webinars, seminars, and industry events.
* Generate qualified leads through targeted prospecting campaigns.
* Collaborate with marketing teams on product positioning and campaigns.
* Track market trends, customer requirements, and competitor activities.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronics, Electrical, Telecommunications, or a related engineering discipline.
* 5–10 years of experience in EDA software technical sales, product management, or business development.
* Understanding of RF/microwave engineering, wireless communications, radar, semiconductor design, and simulation workflows.
* Familiarity with Keysight ADS, SystemVue, EMPro, or equivalent EDA software is advantageous.
* Strong communication, negotiation, presentation, and customer relationship management skills.
* Ability to manage account planning, and OEM relationships.
* Willingness to travel for customer meetings and business development.

**Job Category:** Product Manager – Keysight EDA Solutions

**Job Type:** Full Time

**Job Location:** Bangalore

**Experience:** 5 To 10 Years

**Education:** B.E/B.Tech/M.E/M.Tech in Electrical Electrical and Electronics Engineering Electronics and Communication Engineering

title: Senior Product Manager – Private Markets, Data & Feeds
job_description:
**Role Summary**
----------------

We are seeking an experienced and commercially focused Product Manager to lead the growth and execution of our **Private Markets Data & Feeds proposition** . This role will be responsible for defining and executing the product strategy, commercial roadmap, and go-to-market initiatives for private markets datasets across asset classes including Private Equity, Venture Capital, Private Credit, Infrastructure, and Real Assets.

The successful candidate will act as the intersection between clients, sales, content, technology, and strategic partners to deliver data products that meet the evolving needs of institutional investors, quantitative researchers, asset managers, wealth managers, banks, and alternative investment firms.

This is a highly visible role with responsibility for driving revenue growth, client adoption, product innovation, and market positioning within a rapidly expanding private markets ecosystem.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Product Strategy & Commercial Leadership**

* Define and execute the commercial strategy for the Private Markets Data & Feeds business.
* Develop product vision, roadmap, and business cases aligned with client demand and market trends.
* Identify new revenue opportunities through new content offerings, delivery channels, partnerships, and licensing models.
* Establish pricing, packaging, and commercialization strategies to maximize market penetration and profitability.
* Own product P&L, growth targets, and business performance metrics.

### **Client & Market Engagement**

* Engage directly with Investment Banking, buy-side, sell-side, wealth, and research clients to understand current and emerging use cases.
* Translate client requirements into scalable product capabilities and data solutions.
* Represent the business externally at client meetings, industry conferences, webinars, and strategic forums.
* Gather competitive intelligence and monitor developments across private markets, alternative investments, and data providers.

### **Product Development & Execution**

* Partner closely with data Strategy, engineering, data operations, and delivery teams to prioritize product enhancements.
* Define requirements for data models, coverage expansion, feed structures, APIs, cloud delivery, and integration capabilities.
* Drive agile product development processes and ensure successful product launches.
* Monitor client feedback and usage analytics to identify product improvement opportunities.

### **Commercial & Go-To-Market Execution**

* Enable Sales and Customer Success teams through value propositions, positioning, competitive messaging, and sales collateral.
* Support major commercial opportunities, RFPs, strategic negotiations, and client onboarding activities.
* Develop market segmentation strategies and targeted growth plans for key client segments.
* Establish KPIs and monitor adoption, retention, revenue growth, and client satisfaction.

### **Strategic Partnerships**

* Identify and develop strategic relationships with private market participants, data providers, technology platforms, and ecosystem partners.
* Evaluate build-versus-buy opportunities and support acquisition, partnership, and investment initiatives.
Drive integration and commercialization of third-party datasets where appropriate.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Data Science, or related discipline.
* 8+ years of experience in Product Management, Commercial Product Strategy, Market Data, Financial Information Services, or Alternative Investments.
* Strong understanding of Private Markets, including:
  + - M&A
  + - Equity New Issues
  + - Debt New issues
  + - Loans
  + - Repurchases
  + - Joint Venture
  + - Shareholder Activism
  + - Poinson Pill
  + - Municipals
  + - Sustainable Finance
  + - Private Equity
  + - Private Credit
  + - Real Assets
  + - Fund performance & Benchmarking
* Experience managing enterprise data products, data feeds, APIs, or cloud-based data distribution platforms.
* Demonstrated success driving product growth and commercial outcomes.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence across multiple teams and senior leadership levels.
* Excellent presentation, communication, and client-facing skills.

* Experience within financial data providers, exchanges, investment research firms, alternative data vendors, or private markets technology platforms.
* Deep knowledge of institutional investor workflows and investment research processes.
* Familiarity with cloud data delivery platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Understanding of quantitative investment workflows and data integration requirements.

**Career Stage:**

Manager  
  
  

**LSEG unlocks the power of markets to create opportunities across the global economy.**

Through our connected network of market infrastructure, data and analytics, we help customers access capital, manage risk and make confident decisions.

  
  

Our insights bring clarity to complex markets, and our trusted services ensure resilience and stability. With deep expertise and global scale, we partner with customers to drive innovation and shape the future of finance.

  

Few organisations operate at the scale, complexity and reach of LSEG. Here, you’ll work alongside experts, be inspired to deliver your best work and help shape what’s next for our business and the global economy.

  
  

Guided by our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change, we bring together diverse perspectives, encourage fresh thinking, and create an environment where learning never stops.

  

Join more than 26,000 colleagues across 60 countries, supporting customers in over 170 countries. Alongside flexible ways of working, you'll have access to benefits that support your wellbeing and your future, including 26 weeks' parental leave, healthcare, retirement planning and a wellness allowance. Through the LSEG Foundation and two paid volunteering days each year, you’ll also have opportunities to get involved in your local community and support causes that matter to you.

  
  

We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone’s race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs.

  
  

Please take a moment to read this privacy notice carefully, as it describes what personal information London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) (we) may hold about you, what it’s used for, and how it’s obtained, your rights and how to contact us as a data subject .

  

By clicking on "Apply", the process for submitting an application will begin. If you have any questions prior to clicking "Apply", please contact the recruiter.

  
  

If you are submitting as a Recruitment Agency Partner, it is essential and your responsibility to ensure that candidates applying to LSEG are aware of this privacy notice.

  
  

***LSEG. Make more possible.***

**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Role Summary:  
The Sr. Product Manager is responsible for directing product strategy from conception and definition through implementation. This role identifies new business and market opportunities and creates appropriate business plans. Responsibilities include determining the market for the product, understanding marketplace requirements, and ensuring consistency of new products with the organization’s image and objectives. The Sr. Product Manager functions as a central resource, interacting with systems, marketing, and sales during the product development stage, and formulates and executes long-term plans for cost and profit control. The role also promotes the use of new technologies and industry-leading trends.  
  
All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work.  
  
Key Responsibilities:

* Direct product strategy from conception through implementation.
* Identify new business and market opportunities and develop business plans.
* Determine product market requirements and ensure alignment with organizational objectives.
* Serve as a central resource interacting with systems, marketing, and sales during product development.
* Formulate and execute long-term plans for cost and profit control.
* Promote adoption of new technologies and industry-leading trends.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

Basic Qualifications:

* 8 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor's Degree or at least 5 years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 2 years of work experience with a PhD.
* Experience in roles such as product manager, product owner, business process analyst, or sales operations.
* Experience in applying Agile principles across design, development, testing, and product management.
* Experience in developing software capabilities to support sales, service, or customer relationship management functions.
* Experience in multi-tasking, organizing, managing, and implementing complex projects directly or through supervision.
* Experience in cross-functional collaboration with systems, marketing, and sales teams.

Preferred Qualifications:

* 9 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor's Degree or 7 or more relevant years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 3 or more years of experience with a PhD.
* Agile certifications such as CSM and CSPO, or their equivalent.
* Experience in identifying, assessing, and managing tradeoffs in product development.
* Experience in identifying points of failure and formulating error-handling approaches for product resiliency.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Product Manager III, InsurTech (Risk Based Intelligence)
job_description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

  

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

**Product Manager III, InsurTech (Risk Intelligence & Scoring)**  
  
  
**About the Product Team**  
  
The Product Team creates high-quality end-to-end experiences for travellers, partners, and Expedia Group. Our focus on customer-centric innovation enables us to develop products that build loyalty and repeat business. We partner closely with teams across Expedia Group to drive growth and achieve results for our customers and the company.
  
  
**About InsurTech and this role**  
  
The InsurTech Product team creates peace of mind so travellers can book and travel with confidence. This role sits at the intersection of InsurTech, FinTech, Data Science, and Platform Product Management, focusing on **Risk Intelligence and Scoring** .
  
  
Y

ou will help define and build the risk signals, predictive models, decisioning services, and scoring capabilities that power protection and fintech products across Expedia Group brands. These capabilities will enable accurate risk assessment, pricing optimization, underwriting decisions, fraud and loss mitigation, and monetization strategies that account for inventory arbitrage, pricing volatility, and demand fluctuations.
  
  
Working closely with Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, and business stakeholders, you will shape the foundational platforms, integrations, and operating models that allow our protection and financial products to scale globally, remain compliant across markets, and deliver sustainable business growth. Your success will come from simplifying complex systems, unlocking new platform capabilities, and using data-driven insights to drive better commercial and traveler outcomes.
  
  
**In this role, you will**

  

* Own the strategy, roadmap, execution, and adoption of **Risk Intelligence and Scoring** capabilities, including risk signals, predictive scores, and decisioning services that support protection and fintech products across Expedia Group brands and markets.
* Define product strategies that optimize pricing decisions, product recommendations, inventory utilization, risk-adjusted profitability, and demand predictability.
* Identify opportunities to leverage data, AI, and machine learning to improve risk assessment, predictive decisioning, commercial optimization, and product performance.
* Translate product strategy into clear requirements, prioritization frameworks, and execution plans while managing dependencies across multiple teams and complex platform initiatives.
* Drive 0-to-1 innovation by identifying and launching new monetization opportunities enabled through risk prediction, demand forecasting, price predictability, and decision intelligence.
* Bring execution rigor to turn these opportunities into 0-to-1 launches: scope tightly, sequence milestones, manage risks and dependencies, and ship on time and at quality, working hand in hand with UX Design, backend platform teams, Finance, and Tax.

* Understand the value of fast, quality delivery: balance speed with reliability, compliance, and customer experience, using MVPs, experiments, and phased rollouts to learn quickly and scale what works.
Work directly with senior product leaders and executives, using exceptional presentation and storytelling skills to communicate strategy, trade-offs, and results clearly, and to influence leaders and stakeholders to back key decisions and investments.  

  

**Experience and qualifications**

  

* 5+ years of Product Management experience, including platform, technical, or data-driven products serving multiple teams or business lines.
* Experience in FinTech, InsurTech, Payments, Marketplace, Travel, or E-commerce domains is strongly preferred. Experience with risk, fraud, underwriting, credit scoring, pricing, or decisioning platforms is highly desirable.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Proven track record of taking products from idea to launch: you have personally led multiple 0-to-1 launches end to end, from discovery and requirements through build, rollout, and post-launch adoption, partnering with UX Design, backend platform teams, Finance, and Tax.
* Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with a solid understanding of machine learning, predictive analytics, statistical modeling, experimentation, and data-driven decision making.
* Familiarity with forecasting, risk scoring, pricing optimization, demand prediction, inventory economics, and commercial decisioning frameworks.
* Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and align stakeholders across multiple organizations to drive outcomes and investment.
* Experience operating in regulated environments such as insurance, financial services, payments, or travel, including an understanding of compliance and risk management considerations, is a strong plus.

**Accommodation requests**

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job\_accommodation .

  

**About Expedia Group**

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

  

**Important notice**

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/ .

  

**Equal Opportunity**

Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.
