Your success will come from simplifying complex systems, unlocking new platform capabilities, and using data-driven insights to drive better commercial and traveler outcomes.
  
  
**In this role, you will**

  

* Own the strategy, roadmap, execution, and adoption of **Risk Intelligence and Scoring** capabilities, including risk signals, predictive scores, and decisioning services that support protection and fintech products across Expedia Group brands and markets.
* Define product strategies that optimize pricing decisions, product recommendations, inventory utilization, risk-adjusted profitability, and demand predictability.
* Identify opportunities to leverage data, AI, and machine learning to improve risk assessment, predictive decisioning, commercial optimization, and product performance.
* Translate product strategy into clear requirements, prioritization frameworks, and execution plans while managing dependencies across multiple teams and complex platform initiatives.
* Drive 0-to-1 innovation by identifying and launching new monetization opportunities enabled through risk prediction, demand forecasting, price predictability, and decision intelligence.
* Bring execution rigor to turn these opportunities into 0-to-1 launches: scope tightly, sequence milestones, manage risks and dependencies, and ship on time and at quality, working hand in hand with UX Design, backend platform teams, Finance, and Tax.

* Understand the value of fast, quality delivery: balance speed with reliability, compliance, and customer experience, using MVPs, experiments, and phased rollouts to learn quickly and scale what works.
Work directly with senior product leaders and executives, using exceptional presentation and storytelling skills to communicate strategy, trade-offs, and results clearly, and to influence leaders and stakeholders to back key decisions and investments.  

  

**Experience and qualifications**

  

* 5+ years of Product Management experience, including platform, technical, or data-driven products serving multiple teams or business lines.
* Experience in FinTech, InsurTech, Payments, Marketplace, Travel, or E-commerce domains is strongly preferred. Experience with risk, fraud, underwriting, credit scoring, pricing, or decisioning platforms is highly desirable.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Proven track record of taking products from idea to launch: you have personally led multiple 0-to-1 launches end to end, from discovery and requirements through build, rollout, and post-launch adoption, partnering with UX Design, backend platform teams, Finance, and Tax.
* Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with a solid understanding of machine learning, predictive analytics, statistical modeling, experimentation, and data-driven decision making.
* Familiarity with forecasting, risk scoring, pricing optimization, demand prediction, inventory economics, and commercial decisioning frameworks.
* Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and align stakeholders across multiple organizations to drive outcomes and investment.
* Experience operating in regulated environments such as insurance, financial services, payments, or travel, including an understanding of compliance and risk management considerations, is a strong plus.

Noida

**Qualifications:**

BE/BTech/MCA or any relevant degree with a background in consumer internet products

4-6 years’ experience delivering highly successful and innovative products with your fingerprints all over them -you’re extremely proud of what you’ve accomplished.

You carry the optimum blend of business, creativity (UI/UX) and technology.

You are hands-on and go-getter to build & enhance your product through teamwork.

You are on a constant drive to expand the product through research & stitching new partnerships.

You’re expected to be a polymath who can bring ideas and analogies from different domains to solve a problem. You should be able to understand third or fourth level metrics.

Stellar design instincts and product taste

Finger-tippiness with data: you just go get the data you need with no muss/fuss and can whip it into an insightful story with no help. You know how to leverage data to make decisions without getting stuck in analysis paralysis.

Grittiness: You never hesitate to roll up your sleeves and tackle something hands-on, you persevere when others fall away.

Own product charter & build Product Roadmap

Develop Wireframe & PRD for new features / services.

Understand Digital Technologies involved in responsive web development & API Integrations.

Hands-on experience on various product development and product management tools including but limited to Jira / Confluence / Miro / Google Analytics / Martech / CRM.

Candidates from a travel & accommodation (Market place, Property Management System and Channel Manager) background will be preferred.

Should have experience in managing B2C/B2B products - responsive web & mobile app(Android/iOS) user Interfaces.

Most importantly, you should be fun to work with.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Manage Responsive Web,Mobile App, CRM, Property Management System, and all other major building blocks.

Driving Lead & Conversion Growth - Visitor to Lead & Lead to Successful Closure through UX, Research, Data driven Features and meticulous execution.

Break silos, drive wow experiences and create efficiencies through digital adoptions.

You’ll be responsible for absorbing all the complexities of the domain and making simple, elegant and polished products for our users. You’ll have to learn and unlearn fast across domains.

You’ll be working closely with the engineers, designers and analysts and marketing team who care deeply about their product. You should be able to quickly build rapport with them. Persuasiveness is more valued here than authority.

You’ll be owning product charters and would be responsible for every delivery. Your product charter will change as we evolve.

You should be able to understand macro changes in the market and identify potential opportunities and risks. You should be able to plan features in smaller sprints while keeping an eye on the larger vision.

You’ll be extremely meticulous and prudent in testing every feature that goes out. We ship high quality software.

You’ll be the internal evangelist of the product who will go to everyone and help them understand why we should build a feature.

**Soft Skills:**

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Ability to work independently and meet tight deadlines.

Team player who can adapt to new and evolving processes.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager
job_description:
**Company Description**

Launched in 2007 by Aloke Bajpai & Rajnish Kumar, ixigo (Le Travenues Technology Limited) is a technology company focused on empowering Indian travellers to plan, book and manage their trips across rail, air, buses and hotels. ixigo assists travellers in making smarter travel decisions by leveraging artificial intelligence. The ixigo, ConfirmTkt and AbhiBus apps allow travellers to book train tickets, flight tickets, bus tickets, hotels, and cabs, and provide travel utility tools and services developed using in-house proprietary algorithms and crowd-sourced information. With over 54 crore Annual Active Users in Fiscal 2025, ixigo is the leading OTA for Next Billion Users in India. For more information, please visit http://www.ixigo.com

 **Job Description**

**About the Role:**

As a Product Manager - Flights at ixigo, you will work on the end-to-end flights product, driving growth across the booking funnel while ensuring a reliable, trustworthy experience across the customer journey.

You will balance user experience, business growth, and operational efficiency across a high-volume, high-stakes product area.

**Responsibilities:**

* Flights Product Strategy: Define and execute the roadmap for the flights business, balancing growth, conversion, and customer experience priorities across the funnel
* Post-Booking Experience: Own key post-booking journeys including cancellations, rescheduling, and refunds, working with CX teams to identify and resolve recurring customer pain points
* Booking Funnel Optimization: Own and continuously improve the search-to-book funnel, search relevance, seat/meal selection, add-ons — to reduce drop-offs and improve conversion at every step
* Partner Onboarding & Distribution: Lead the onboarding of new airlines, GDS/NDC partners, and supply sources to expand flight inventory. Additionally, own the B2B API distribution charter — onboarding partners who wish to integrate our flight APIs to sell flights on their own platforms, defining API/product requirements, and ensuring smooth technical and commercial integration for these partners
* Continuous Experimentation: Champion A/B testing across search, discounting, and checkout flows to systematically improve conversion and revenue metrics
* Cross-functional Collaboration: Act as the central node between Design, Backend, Frontend, Analytics, and the AI/ML teams. You will translate complex business needs into PRDs and user-centric designs
* Data-Driven Optimization: Define and track North Star metrics such as funnel conversion rate, supply coverage, partner integration TAT, and customer satisfaction, using these insights to guide roadmap decisions

 **Qualifications**

**Qualifications:**

* 2-5 years of experience in Product Management, ideally within a high-growth B2C tech company, OTA, or travel-tech setting. Experience with funnel optimization, marketplace/supply growth, or partner integrations is a strong plus
* Funnel & Growth Mindset: Strong understanding of conversion funnels and the ability to identify and prioritize high-impact optimizations across search, pricing, and checkout
* User-Centric Mindset: An eye for great UX/UI and a solid understanding of the end-to-end travel booking experience, including post-booking needs
* Technical Fluency: Comfortable discussing API/integration structures with backend teams and airline/GDS systems
* Execution Excellence: Proven ability to manage complex, cross-functional projects with multiple stakeholders and ship reliable, high-quality features in an agile environment

**Additional (Preferred):**

* OTA Experience: Familiarity with the nuances of the Indian travel market and seasonal booking patterns
* Partnership & Integration Acumen: Comfort working with airline/GDS/NDC partners and translating commercial and technical integration requirements into a clear onboarding roadmap
* AI/ML Exposure: Direct experience working with data science teams to deploy machine learning models
* Growth Mindset: A "hacker" mentality—constantly looking for small tweaks that lead to outsized gains in conversion

 **Additional Information**

Candidates are responsible for safeguarding sensitive company data against unauthorized access, use, or disclosure, and for reporting any suspected security incidents in line with the organization's ISMS (Information Security Management System) policies and procedures.

title: Senior Product Manager - Life Insurance & Annuity
job_description:
**WHO WE ARE:**

Zinnia is the leading technology platform for accelerating life and annuities growth. With innovative enterprise solutions and data insights, Zinnia simplifies the experience of buying, selling, and administering insurance products. All of which enables more people to protect their financial futures. Our success is driven by a commitment to three core values: be bold, team up, deliver value – and that we do. Zinnia has over $180 billion in assets under administration, serves 100+ carrier clients, 2500 distributors and partners, and over 2 million policyholders.

**WHO YOU ARE:**

The Senior Product Manager leads the Product Life Cycle and strongly contributes to the research & development activities related to the design and development of our products and qualification or re-qualification of new and existing products. The individual will work with Zinnia's Product Organization to ensure alignment with organization's strategy and vision.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**

* Lead & contribute into the execution of product lifecycle processes for our Insurtech products/platforms, work with cross-functional teams to ensure fulfilment of product requirements, evaluates product performance and transition products from development to commercialization.
* Lead technical discussions with Engineering teams & thoroughly manage technical/business requirements.
* Assists in determining product delivery and deployment dates for new product releases, feature and maintenance releases and regular corrective service or service pack releases.
* Mentor a lean team of Product Managers while acting as a technical consultant to the product organization and leads research and prototyping of innovative technologies and products.
* Ensures the technology and architectural roadmap of engineering is properly aligned with and supports the product/business road map
* Acts as a customer liaison on technical issues related to product integration, custom development and requirements.
* May lead major releases and ensure feature enhancements respond to customer requests.
* Responsible for product delivery managing schedules and tasks related to all aspects of product development.

**WHAT YOU'LL NEED:**

* **9+ years of experience into Product Management, including analyzing software/product design, development, and deployment.**
* **Domain expertise in US Life Insurance & Annuity.**
* Bachelor's/Master's or equivalent Degree in technology or related field
* **Strong Background of working as a Technical & Functional Product Manager or Business Analyst/Product Analyst in an enterprise environment.**
* **Hands-on understanding of API Integration, SQL, Data Analysis etc.**
* **Strong understanding of SDLC & technology system interfaces, data integration.**
* An SME who performs work with a high degree of latitude; handles the most complex issues.
* Possess strong Communication skills, Problem-solving & Analytical thinking skills.
* Can lead individual assignments & deliver with strong expertise
* Expert level experience in delivery methodologies (Scrum/Kanban) and the use of relevant tools
* Ability to influence, lead, and work as part of a cross-functional in a global team setup

**WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?**

Zinnia offers excellent career progression and competitive compensation. We offer great benefits, including health/dental insurance, parental leave, profit sharing, PF, incentive/bonus opportunity, tuition reimbursement, and so much more. We're looking for the best and brightest innovators in the industry to join our team. At Zinnia, you collaborate with smart, creative professionals who are dedicated to delivering cutting-edge technologies, deeper data insights, and enhanced services to transform how insurance is done. Visit our website at www.zinnia.com for more information. Apply by completing the online application on the careers section of our website. We are an Equal Opportunity employer committed to a diverse workforce. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability.

**Product Manager – Audio Visual Solutions**

We are looking for a **Product Manager – Audio Visual Solutions** with hands-on experience in designing, configuring, implementing, and supporting AV solutions.

**Key Responsibilities:**

· Understand customer requirements and propose suitable AV solutions.

· Work with OEMs and technology partners to design cost-effective solutions.

· Manage and support Conference Room & Boardroom Solutions, Audio Visual Displays, Digital Signage, Kiosks, Multi-Panel Video Walls, and related technologies.

· Support the sales team with solution presentations, demos, and proposal preparation.

· Train technical teams on installation, configuration, and support.

· Educate and enable sales teams to identify opportunities and generate leads.

**Requirements:**

· Graduate in Engineering, IT, Electronics, or a related field.

· Proven experience in AV solutions, display technologies, and system integration.

· Strong techno-commercial skills with the ability to align customer needs with appropriate solutions.

· Excellent communication and presentation skills.

· Willingness to travel for customer meetings, site visits, and project support.

**Interested candidates may send their updated resume to hr@turbonet.co.in with the subject line: "Application – Product Manager – Audio Visual Solutions".**

Pay: ₹35,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Product Manager-Components
job_description:
Job Description

Position: Product Manager-Components

Reporting: Global Technical Lead

Job Location: Mumbai

Grade Level: Management

Purpose:

Product Manager Components will be responsible for managing and developing lubricant additive components. The

role involves technical evaluation, product development, performance testing, troubleshooting and providing technical

support to customers, suppliers and internal business teams.

The position requires strong technical knowledge of lubricant additives chemistries, base oils, finished lubricants,

testing methodologies and industry standards, along with the ability to coordinate technical projects and ensure

successful product qualification.

Responsibilities:

Technical Product Development & Management

 Manage and develop lubricant additive components and formulations for various applications.

 Evaluate raw materials, base oils, additive packages and their compatibility.

 Identify opportunities for new product development and improvement of existing formulations.

 Conduct technical assessments of product performance and suitability for different applications.

 Coordinate with suppliers and manufacturers for technical specifications and product improvements.

 Coordinate with external laboratories for product testing and evaluation.

 Review and interpret laboratory test reports and technical data.

 Ensure testing is conducted as per applicable ASTM, ISO and other international standards.

 Evaluate test results and recommend necessary formulation improvements.

 Monitor product quality, consistency and performance against specifications.

Customer Technical Support

 Provide technical assistance and solutions to customers as per lubricant application.

 Handle technical queries, product complaints and troubleshooting requirements.

 Conduct technical discussions and presentations with customers.

 Support customer product trials, field evaluations and product qualification.

 Coordinate with the sales team to understand customer requirements and provide appropriate technical

solutions.

Supplier & Vendor Coordination

 Coordinate with global additive manufacturers, component suppliers and technical partners.

 Obtain and evaluate technical data sheets (TDS), safety data sheets (SDS), certificates of analysis (COA) and

product specifications.

 Review new products and assess their technical suitability.

 Maintain technical communication with international suppliers and partners.

Technical Documentation & Compliance

 Prepare and maintain technical reports, product specifications and evaluation reports.

 Maintain product development records and technical documentation.

 Ensure compliance with relevant industry standards and customer requirements.

 Support product qualification, technical audits and customer assessments.

 Maintain updated technical databases for products, components and formulations.

Team & Project Coordination

 Coordinate with internal technical, sales, operations and laboratory teams.

 Monitor technical projects and ensure completion within agreed timelines.

 Provide technical guidance and support to team members.

 Participate in customer meetings, technical conferences, exhibitions and industry events.

 Submit regular technical progress reports to management.

Qualifications & Experience required:

Qualification: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Petroleum Technology, Lubricant

Technology or a related discipline. Additional qualifications or certifications in lubricant technology and additive

chemistry will be an advantage.

Level of experience: 8–12 years of relevant experience in the lubricant additives, lubricants, petroleum or specialty

chemicals industry.

Technical skills: Strong understanding of lubricant additive chemistry, base oils and finished lubricant formulations.

Product development, technical evaluation and performance testing. Understanding of engine oils, industrial lubricants,

greases and specialty lubricants. Knowledge of ASTM, API, ACEA and relevant international specifications. Knowledge of

tribology testing, good analytical skills. Technical writing, Proven customer focus.

Behavioural competencies: Excellent communication and technical presentation skills, good interpersonal skills, team

spirit, open mindedness, sense of creativity.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

 Successful completion of technical development and product qualification projects.

 Timely resolution of customer technical queries and complaints.

 Accuracy and quality of technical evaluations and reports.

 Successful coordination of laboratory testing and product validation.

 Development and improvement of lubricant additive components and formulations.

 Technical support provided to sales and business development teams.

 Effective supplier and customer technical coordination.

 Achievement of project milestones within agreed timelines.

Stakeholders

Internal: Global Technical Head / Director – Technical & Technology, Technical Team, Sales & Business Development

Team, Operations & Administration Team

External: Suppliers, customers, OEM, third party labs, Universities, consultants and industry partners

General Expectations

 Maintain confidentiality of company information, formulations and technical data.

 Demonstrate professional conduct in all internal and external communications.

 Take ownership of assigned technical responsibilities and projects.

 Maintain a customer-focused and solution-oriented approach.

 Be willing to travel domestically and internationally as per business requirements.

Pay: ₹1,000,000.00 - ₹2,000,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Product Manager
job_description:
**About the Role and Team:**

A hybrid Product Manager role embedded within the Data Science team. You'll own the product direction for ML-driven capabilities — bidding algorithms, traffic quality (fraud detection), and audience modeling — while maintaining the operational rigor required for MRC/TAG compliance. You'll be part of the broader PM community, following established practices and gradually expanding your scope.

**We hope you are ready to change the game! Be ready to:**

**Product Management**

* Own and prioritize the Data Science team backlog; define user stories and acceptance criteria
* Lead scopes where domain knowledge is primarily algorithm/ML-driven; support cross team scopes as a secondary PM
* Participate in roadmap planning, sprint planning, and PM syncs, and uphold established PM ways of working — from templates and documentation standards to consistent communication and proactive
* stakeholder management
* Bridge Product leadership and Data Scientists — translate business needs into technical priorities and vice versa
    
    
  **Algorithm Analysis & Validation**
* Analyze and validate ML algorithm outputs (bidding, delivery predictions, audience models) against business KPIs
* Test model outputs, identify when and why algorithms underperform, and provide actionable feedback to data scientists
* Conduct advanced investigation and analysis for algorithm-related performance issues
* Support A/B test design and analysis for algorithm changes
    
    
  **Ad & Traffic Quality (Fraud) Operations**
* Investigate fraud-related issues — IP/domain/app unblocking, ads.txt issues, discrepancy reports, DOOH/CTV/Retail Media whitelisting
* Manage fraud blacklists (IP, domain, UA, app) using internal tools
* Run compliance cycles — Backward Looking Assessments, quarterly risk assessments, IVT filter reviews,
* TAG/IWL list updates, methodology disclosures — and look for opportunities to AI automate the recurring,
* Repeatable parts rather than only running them manually
* Support TAG/MRC audits and contribute to RFI/RFP responses on traffic quality
    
    
  **Industry & AI Awareness**
* Track AdTech trends, AI/ML developments, and competitive landscape to inform priorities

**Attitude First. Everything else will follow. We can grow together faster if you have:**

* 3–5 years in a product, analytics, or technical role working alongside data science/ML teams
* 1–2 years of experience in AdTech or programmatic advertising
* Hands-on experience testing or analyzing ML model outputs (not building them)
* Strong analytical skills — SQL, data analysis tools, basic statistics
* Solid product fundamentals — backlog management, stakeholder alignment, acceptance criteria
* Excellent communication — can explain algorithm behavior to non-technical stakeholders

**Stand out by having:**

* Comfort working in an AI-native way — using LLMs and AI tooling to accelerate analysis, drafting, and
* Investigation, and a sense for where recurring workflows can be automated rather than just executed
* Familiarity with ad fraud / IVT concepts and MRC/TAG standards
* Experience with A/B testing and experimentation frameworks
* Python/R for data exploration

**Our promise to you:**

* A dynamic, inspiring, and international environment filled with ambitious and caring colleagues

* Premium health insurance with ₹10,00,000 coverage for you and your family

* 24 paid vacation days to enjoy life outside of work

* Paid maternity (6 months) and paternity (2 weeks)

* Annual learning budget to help you grow your skills and support continuous learning

* Rewarding referral program for helping us grow

* Global perks such as birthday gifts, work anniversaries, and company events to connect with colleagues and have fun

* And much more – join us to explore the full experience

**Diversity & Inclusion @Adform:**

Adform is an equal opportunity employer with a global perspective. We remain committed to creating an environment that not only respects different backgrounds but celebrates them too. We believe that diversity in all its forms enhances our teams’ creativity, innovation, and effectiveness, and therefore we value different backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

We are committed to creating a work environment where Adform employees feel valued for who they are and what they can contribute, free from any type of discrimination.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager - Monetisation & Payments
job_description:
**InMobi (Corporate)**

InMobi Group is a global technology company shaping the future of agentic commerce and advertising. Through its ecosystem of businesses — including InMobi Advertising and flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi leverages data, machine learning, and generative AI to help brands reach audiences more precisely and consumers discover products more intuitively. Glance, which is pioneering new models of agentic commerce, is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd.

**InMobi Advertising**

InMobi Advertising, part of global technology company InMobi, is an agentic advertising platform helping brands and merchants achieve their business outcomes. Through its proprietary intelligence, AI-led solutions, and vast consumer reach — including flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi Advertising delivers the omnichannel performance defining what's next in advertising and commerce. Glance is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd. To learn more, visit advertising.inmobi.com.

**Glance**

Glance is an intelligent shopping agent, redefining the commerce experience. Powered by proprietary agentic intelligence and generative AI, Glance delivers a hyper-personalized consumer experience across mobile and TV — shaping the new era of shopping. Glance is operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of global technology leader InMobi, and is backed by Mithril Capital, Google and Jio Platforms. To learn more, visit glance.com.

**About Accelerate:**  
Accelerate is InMobi's AI-native, self-serve campaign management platform for SMBs, D2C brands, agencies and enterprise advertisers. An advertiser describes their brand and goals; Accelerate's agents plan, create, launch and optimize campaigns across ad platforms such as TikTok and OpenAI, with more supply integrations on the way.  
We are building toward a fully autonomous marketing platform. The product team is organized by capability, not segment. This role sits on the demand side, reporting to the Group Product Manager, alongside Customer Experience Core (campaign creation, onboarding and activation).  
  
**About the role:**  
You will build Accelerate's payments and money infrastructure from zero. Every dollar or rupee an advertiser puts into Accelerate flows through what you build: how they fund their account, how spend is drawn down across ad platforms, how they are invoiced, refunded and taxed, and how we settle with suppliers.  
There is no legacy system to inherit. You will define the wallet, the ledger behind it, and the integration with our third-party payments partner (Vyre), then own the revenue metrics that depend on them. Getting this right is what lets an SMB go from signup to live campaign in minutes, and what lets finance trust every number on the dashboard.  
You will work with a Senior Product Associate on the pod, engineering, Central Design, and InMobi finance, tax and legal teams.

**What you will own:**

* Advertiser wallet. A prepaid balance advertisers top up and Accelerate draws down as campaigns spend. Includes funding methods, auto-recharge, low-balance alerts, credit lines for larger accounts, and the rules for how a balance can and cannot be used.
* Ledger and reconciliation. The source of truth for every credit, debit, hold, refund and adjustment. Spend reported by each ad platform must reconcile to the ledger, with clear handling for mismatches.
* Payments integration. End-to-end integration with Vyre, our third-party payments partner: collections, payment methods, failures and retries, webhooks, and the fallback plan if a provider is down.
* Billing, invoicing and tax. Invoices, receipts, GST, TDS on ad spend, and multi-currency handling as we add international advertisers.
* Supplier settlement. How we pay out and reconcile with ad platforms, working with the business team that handles supplier contracts.
* Segment needs. SMBs prepaying by card or UPI, agencies funding many client accounts from one place, and enterprise clients on invoiced terms.
* Revenue metrics. Top-up conversion, payment success rate, time to first funded campaign, wallet balance retention, and reconciliation accuracy. Every revenue number in Accelerate's success framework depends on your system.

**What we're looking for:**

* 6+ years of product management, with at least 3 years owning payments, wallets, billing or ledger systems.
* You have built a payments or wallet system from scratch, or led its first major version. Scaling a mature system alone is not enough.
* Deep understanding of double-entry ledgers, idempotency, reconciliation, refunds and chargebacks. You can sit with engineers and discuss failure modes, not just flows.
* Hands-on experience integrating a third-party payment provider or aggregator end to end.
* Working knowledge of Indian payments regulation and tax: RBI rules on prepaid instruments, GST, TDS. You know when to bring in legal and what to ask them.
* You work AI-native (see "How we work" below). You prototype, write and reason with LLMs as part of your daily work.
* Clear written communication. You can explain a ledger design to an engineer, a finance controller and an SMB owner, each in their own terms.  
  Strong pluses
* You built a wallet or stored-balance feature inside a non-fintech product, such as a marketplace, mobility, food delivery or SaaS platform.
* Experience with ad-platform billing (prepaid, postpaid or credit-line models) or marketplace payouts.
* Experience with cross-border payments, multi-currency balances or FX.
* Experience with B2B billing for agencies or multi-entity accounts.
* Some time as an engineer, or comfort reading API docs and querying data directly.

**How we work:**  
Accelerate is an AI-native product, and we build it the AI-native way. Every PM on the demand side is expected to:

* Prototype before you spec. Turn an idea into a clickable prototype with AI tools in hours, and test it with users and the team before writing requirements.
* Write and think with LLMs. Draft PRDs, edge cases, test cases and analyses with an LLM as a working partner. Then apply your own judgment to what it gets wrong.
* Hand off with less back-and-forth. Give engineering and design specs precise enough to build from, with prototypes and acceptance criteria attached, so fewer decisions get made in meetings.
* Stay close to the data. Pull and analyze data yourself rather than waiting on a dashboard request.
* Bring design sense. Care about the details of the customer experience and partner with design as a peer, not a requester. We will test this in the interview loop, not just ask about it.

Since 2007, InMobi has built the extraordinary. Beyond just technology. It has built a way of working.

Across 16 offices globally, through every pivot and breakthrough, one thing has remained constant: we are builders, dreamers, doers. We are fluid enough to move fast, grounded enough to own outcomes, and human enough to care deeply about the work and about one another.

Culture is at the core of that ethos. It has been co-created by the people who built this company and by those continuing to shape it every day. It lives in how we work, how decisions are made, how teams show up for one another, and how seriously we take the responsibility to build the best.

This is a place where ambition and belonging occupy the same space. Where the bar is high and the support is real. Where freedom comes with trust, and trust comes with accountability. Where you are valued not only for what you do, but for the perspective, judgment and humanity you bring to the work. Where you will be challenged by the work and supported by the communities, passions and experiences that shape who you are beyond your role.

If this sounds like the place you have been looking for, join us.

Find out more here: InMobi Culture

An advertiser describes their brand and goals; Accelerate's agents plan, create, launch and optimize campaigns across ad platforms such as TikTok and OpenAI, with more supply integrations on the way.  
We are building toward a fully autonomous marketing platform. This role sits on the demand side, reporting to the Group Product Manager for Customer Experience Core.  
  
**About the Role:**  
You will own Accelerate's growth engine: getting every advertiser from first visit to a live, performing campaign, and keeping them coming back. This is a Growth PM role with full ownership of user and retention metrics. You will design the journey for each persona, from an SMB owner who has never run an ad to an agency moving dozens of accounts from another tool. You will own signup, ad-account connection, migration of existing accounts and spend history, and the moments that turn a new user into an  
active one.You will run experiments, own the funnel numbers, and work closely with the Core Product Experience and Monetization teams, since activation depends on both a great first campaign and a smooth first payment.

**What you will own:**

* Persona journeys. End-to-end journeys for SMBs, D2C brands, agencies, mid-size advertisers and enterprise teams, from first visit to steady use. You define what "activated" means for each.
* Signup and account connection. Signup, business verification, connecting ad accounts on platforms like TikTok and OpenAI, and linking data sources such as pixels and product catalogs.
* Migration. Bringing existing ad accounts, campaigns and spend history into Accelerate, so advertisers keep their learnings and agencies can move clients in bulk.
* Activation. Time to first live campaign and first results. Includes AI-guided onboarding, where the agent helps users finish setup rather than leaving them with a checklist.
* Retention and lifecycle. Nudges, re-engagement, in-product guidance and email or WhatsApp lifecycle flows that bring users back and grow their usage.
* Experimentation. An experimentation practice for the funnel: hypotheses, A/B tests, analysis and decisions.
* Metrics. Signup-to-activation conversion, time to first live campaign, account connection success rate, week-4 and week-12 retention, and activation by persona and acquisition channel.

  

**What we're looking for:**

* 6+ years of product management, with at least 3 years as a Growth PM owning activation or retention metrics.
* Growth experience in a B2B or merchant-facing self-serve product (SMBs, sellers, restaurants, creators, developers). Consumer-only growth experience is not enough on its own.
* A track record of moving funnel metrics through experiments, with numbers you can explain: baseline, change, and why it worked.
* Strong analytical skills. You write your own SQL or work directly in product analytics tools, and you know when an experiment result is noise.
* Design sense for onboarding: you know how small details in a flow change conversion, and you partner with design as a peer.
* You work AI-native (see "How we work" below). You prototype, write and reason with LLMs as part of your daily work.
* Clear written communication and the ability to align engineering, design, marketing and customer success around a funnel goal.

**Strong pluses:**

* Experience with ad-platform account linking, OAuth integrations, or migrating users and data from a competing product.
* Built AI-guided or conversational onboarding in production.
* Experience with agency or multi-account onboarding.
* Experience with lifecycle tools and channels (email, push, WhatsApp) and the experimentation platforms behind them.
* Experience in martech or adtech, or time running performance marketing yourself.

**How we work:**  
Accelerate is an AI-native product, and we build it the AI-native way. Every PM on the demand side is expected to:

* Prototype before you spec. Turn an idea into a clickable prototype with AI tools in hours, and test it with users and the team before writing requirements.
* Write and think with LLMs. Draft PRDs, edge cases, test cases, and analyses with an LLM as a working partner. Then apply your own judgment to what it gets wrong.
* Hand off with less back-and-forth. Give engineering and design specs precise enough to build from, with prototypes and acceptance criteria attached, so fewer decisions get made in meetings.
* Stay close to the data. Pull and analyze data yourself rather than waiting on a dashboard request.
* Bring design sense. Care about the details of the customer experience and partner with design as a peer, not a requester. We will test this in the interview loop, not just ask about it.

Since 2007, InMobi has built the extraordinary. Beyond just technology. It has built a way of working.

Across 16 offices globally, through every pivot and breakthrough, one thing has remained constant: we are builders, dreamers, doers. We are fluid enough to move fast, grounded enough to own outcomes, and human enough to care deeply about the work and about one another.

Culture is at the core of that ethos. It has been co-created by the people who built this company and by those continuing to shape it every day. It lives in how we work, how decisions are made, how teams show up for one another, and how seriously we take the responsibility to build the best.

This is a place where ambition and belonging occupy the same space. Where the bar is high and the support is real. Where freedom comes with trust, and trust comes with accountability. Where you are valued not only for what you do, but for the perspective, judgment and humanity you bring to the work. Where you will be challenged by the work and supported by the communities, passions and experiences that shape who you are beyond your role.

If this sounds like the place you have been looking for, join us.

job_description:
**Senior Product Manager / Staff Product Manager – AI & Intelligent Systems**

**Experience:** 6–12 Years

**Build the Next Generation of Production-Grade AI Products!**

Are you excited about building AI products that go beyond integrating LLM APIs and conventional AI features?

We are looking for a technically strong **Senior Product Manager – AI** to own the vision and development of intelligent, AI-native products. You will work at the intersection of Product, Engineering and AI/ML to solve complex problems, build scalable AI systems and take them from 0-to-1 experimentation to production deployment.

This is an opportunity to shape products powered by LLMs, AI agents and intelligent automation, with real-world impact at scale.

***What You'll Do***

* **Own AI Product Strategy:** Define product vision, roadmap and execution for complex AI-powered products from 0-to-1.
* **Build Production-Grade AI Systems:** Drive AI capabilities beyond POCs into reliable, scalable systems used by real customers.
* **Drive LLM & Agentic AI Products:** Build products involving LLMs, AI agents, multi-agent workflows, tool calling and orchestration.
* **Influence Technical Architecture:** Partner with Engineering and AI/ML teams on system design, APIs, microservices, data pipelines and integrations.
* **Own AI Quality & Evaluation:** Define evaluation frameworks, golden datasets, accuracy benchmarks and continuous feedback loops.
* **Optimise AI Performance:** Drive improvements in model accuracy, latency, cost, reliability and scalability.
* **Lead Cross-Functional Execution:** Translate complex problems into product requirements and drive delivery across Engineering, AI/ML and Design.

***What We're Looking For***

* 6–12 years of experience in Product Management, with strong ownership of technically complex products.
* Proven experience building and scaling **AI/ML-powered products or LLM-based systems**.
* Strong understanding of **Generative AI, LLMs, AI Agents, Agentic Workflows and RAG**.
* Experience taking AI capabilities from experimentation to **production deployment at scale**.
* Strong technical understanding of **distributed systems, microservices, APIs, event-driven architecture and data pipelines**.
* Understanding of **LLM evaluation, model performance, accuracy, monitoring and optimisation**.
* Ability to work closely with engineering teams on architecture, technical specifications and complex trade-offs.
* Strong product thinking, customer discovery, problem-solving and execution skills.

***Good to Have***

* Experience building AI-native products or agentic AI platforms from scratch.
* Exposure to LangGraph, LangChain, vector databases and LLM orchestration frameworks.
* Familiarity with AI observability, model evaluation and automated testing.
* Experience working with applied AI research or ML engineering teams.

Why Join?

* Build cutting-edge AI products beyond conventional AI integrations.
* Solve challenging problems involving LLMs, agents and intelligent systems.
* Own products end-to-end, from strategy and architecture to production adoption.
* Work closely with strong Engineering and AI/ML teams.
* Create products designed for real-world scale, reliability and impact.

**If you are passionate about turning complex AI capabilities into production-grade products, we would love to hear from you!**

Pay: ₹6,000,000.00 - ₹8,000,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* What is your current CTC Breakup ( Fixed + Variable + Stocks)

Experience:

* Agentic AI : 1 year (Required)

Work Location: In person

**Business Area:**

Product Mgmt.

**Seniority Level:**

Mid-Senior level

**Job Description:**

At Cloudera, we empower people to transform complex data into clear and actionable insights. With as much data under management as the hyperscalers, we're the preferred data partner for the top companies in almost every industry. Powered by the relentless innovation of the open source community, Cloudera advances digital transformation for the world’s largest enterprises.

Cloudera is looking for a Senior product manager for the Lakehouse group within the Data Services Pillar. This is a highly visible role that will have a lasting impact on the strategic direction of the company and customer success.

As Senior product manager you will be responsible for all product lifecycle activities from vision to implementation, including customer development, product strategy and roadmap, coordination with engineering, marketing, business development, and substantial pre- and post-sales field engagement. You will serve as an internal and external expert on data collection, movement and processing from the edge across cloud environments to the customer data centers, and work directly with customers and field teams to grow the business.

You are empathetic, data-driven, and relentlessly focused on making your users more productive. Your experience with data collection, data movement and analytics on data in flight enables you to set a compelling vision for your product and ensure its success in the market.

At Cloudera you will work everyday with world-class customers, partners, technical field experts, and software engineers to define and advocate for the future of data collection and movement. We value thoughtfulness, a love of learning new things, creativity, diverse perspectives, and a sense of humor.

**As a Senior Product Manager you will..**
------------------------------------------

* Product design - Functional analysis that identifies the best options for compelling, easy to use software
* Engineering engagement - Close partnership with engineering to understand technical trade-offs and architecture in order to successfully influence product design
* Focus - Constant prioritization across several competing objectives for optimal use of time and resources
* Customer development - In-person and virtual interviews to understand users, priorities and design considerations
* Product and market strategy - Researching market segments, assessing competitive differentiation, creating decision frameworks, formulating hypotheses and advocating direction
* Launch and evangelism - Communicate product vision to press, analysts, and the wider big data ecosystem to create a strong tailwind for Sales; work with product marketing to create product demos and other technical sales tools; develop conference presentations and other collateral to highlight capabilities
* Sales support - Enable our field and partners, and directly support key opportunities
* Organizational leadership - Work with customers, support, and engineering teams to handle and resolve any critical customer issues that arise with our product
* Whatever else is needed to help sell Cloudera products, delight our customers, support our field teams, and help the company grow

**We are excited if you have….**
--------------------------------

* You should be quite familiar with leading practices in data warehousing, data lakehouses, and data lakes..
* Experience building products using technologies such as Apache Iceberg and Apache Polaris is a strong plus.
* Strong understanding of open table formats, metadata management, and data interoperability across analytics platforms.
* Understanding of cloud-native data platforms and services across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
* You have been a product manager, or another business oriented / customer facing technical role where you have delivered innovative products and nurtured their continued success
* You understand what makes great enterprise platform software
* You possess superlative written, verbal, and visual communication skills
* The position will be based out of India

**What you can expect from us:**

* Generous PTO Policy
* Support work life balance with Unplugged Days
* Flexible WFH Policy
* Mental & Physical Wellness programs
* Phone and Internet Reimbursement program
* Access to Continued Career Development
* Comprehensive Benefits and Competitive Packages
* Paid Volunteer Time
* Employee Resource Groups

**Business Area:**

Product Mgmt.

**Seniority Level:**

Mid-Senior level

**Job Description:**

At Cloudera, we empower people to transform complex data into clear and actionable insights. With as much data under management as the hyperscalers, we're the preferred data partner for the top companies in almost every industry. Powered by the relentless innovation of the open source community, Cloudera advances digital transformation for the world’s largest enterprises.

Cloudera is looking for a Senior product manager for the Lakehouse group within the Data Services Pillar. This is a highly visible role that will have a lasting impact on the strategic direction of the company and customer success.

As Senior product manager you will be responsible for all product lifecycle activities from vision to implementation, including customer development, product strategy and roadmap, coordination with engineering, marketing, business development, and substantial pre- and post-sales field engagement. You will serve as an internal and external expert on data collection, movement and processing from the edge across cloud environments to the customer data centers, and work directly with customers and field teams to grow the business.

You are empathetic, data-driven, and relentlessly focused on making your users more productive. Your experience with data collection, data movement and analytics on data in flight enables you to set a compelling vision for your product and ensure its success in the market.

At Cloudera you will work everyday with world-class customers, partners, technical field experts, and software engineers to define and advocate for the future of data collection and movement. We value thoughtfulness, a love of learning new things, creativity, diverse perspectives, and a sense of humor.

**As a Senior Product Manager you will..**
------------------------------------------

* Product design - Functional analysis that identifies the best options for compelling, easy to use software
* Engineering engagement - Close partnership with engineering to understand technical trade-offs and architecture in order to successfully influence product design
* Focus - Constant prioritization across several competing objectives for optimal use of time and resources
* Customer development - In-person and virtual interviews to understand users, priorities and design considerations
* Product and market strategy - Researching market segments, assessing competitive differentiation, creating decision frameworks, formulating hypotheses and advocating direction
* Launch and evangelism - Communicate product vision to press, analysts, and the wider big data ecosystem to create a strong tailwind for Sales; work with product marketing to create product demos and other technical sales tools; develop conference presentations and other collateral to highlight capabilities
* Sales support - Enable our field and partners, and directly support key opportunities
* Organizational leadership - Work with customers, support, and engineering teams to handle and resolve any critical customer issues that arise with our product
* Whatever else is needed to help sell Cloudera products, delight our customers, support our field teams, and help the company grow

**We are excited if you have….**
--------------------------------

* You should be quite familiar with leading practices in data warehousing, data lakehouses, and data lakes..
* Experience building products using technologies such as Apache Iceberg and Apache Polaris is a strong plus.
* Strong understanding of open table formats, metadata management, and data interoperability across analytics platforms.
* Understanding of cloud-native data platforms and services across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
* You have been a product manager, or another business oriented / customer facing technical role where you have delivered innovative products and nurtured their continued success
* You understand what makes great enterprise platform software
* You possess superlative written, verbal, and visual communication skills
* The position will be based out of India

**What you can expect from us:**

* Generous PTO Policy
* Support work life balance with Unplugged Days
* Flexible WFH Policy
* Mental & Physical Wellness programs
* Phone and Internet Reimbursement program
* Access to Continued Career Development
* Comprehensive Benefits and Competitive Packages
* Paid Volunteer Time
* Employee Resource Groups

title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
**Powering the agentic revolution in travel.** Sabre is an AI-native technology leader, backed by one of the world’s largest travel data clouds. Built on an open, modular, cloud-native architecture, Sabre serves as the backbone for both established leaders and bold, new disruptors, guiding them to the next age of travel retailing through intelligent, connected, and personalized experiences. With AI at its core and operating at unparalleled scale, Sabre transforms insights into innovation, empowering airlines, hoteliers, agencies and other partners to retail, distribute and fulfill travel worldwide.

Team Description
  
  
We are seeking a **Senior Product Manager** to join our Digital Experience team. The team owns and scales whitelabel e-commerce and post-booking servicing products for leading global airline partners, connecting complex airline and retailing capabilities with modern digital experiences to deliver seamless traveler journeys.

  

As a Senior Product Manager, you will help drive the roadmap and execution of our **Digital Experience (DX)** product across SabreSonic and SabreMosaic platforms. You will work closely with engineering, architecture, delivery, commercial teams and global airline customers to translate business and customer needs into scalable product capabilities.

  

The role combines product strategy with hands-on execution. You will manage roadmap priorities and customer requirements, guide agile backlogs, partner with technical teams on solution direction, and help evolve our products as the airline industry transitions toward modern Offer & Order retailing.
  
  
**What you'll do**

* Own and evolve product roadmaps for Digital Experience capabilities across SabreSonic and SabreMosaic, balancing strategic roadmap priorities, customer commitments and platform modernization.
* Manage product requirements and priorities for DX and DXCI, including customer change requests, roadmap initiatives and ongoing product enhancements.
* Translate customer and business needs into clearly defined product requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria for agile engineering teams.
* Partner closely with engineering and architecture teams to evaluate solution options, understand technical trade-offs and deliver scalable product capabilities.
* Work directly with global airline customers, delivery teams and commercial stakeholders to understand requirements, identify product gaps and shape product priorities.
* Support the evolution of digital experiences as airline customers transition from traditional PNR-based workflows toward Offer & Order retailing.
* Analyze product issues, customer escalations and maintenance requirements in partnership with engineering and delivery teams, helping determine appropriate product solutions.
* Use customer feedback, product data, industry trends and operational insights to inform prioritization and product decisions.
* Deliver product demonstrations, roadmap discussions and capability presentations to internal stakeholders and global airline customers.
Coordinate across multiple parallel initiatives and customer commitments while maintaining clear prioritization and product direction.  

Qualifications and Education Requirements:

* 5+ years of product management or closely related experience, preferably working with complex enterprise software, e-commerce platforms or high-scale digital products.
* Demonstrated experience owning product capabilities through the full lifecycle, from requirements and prioritization through development, release and ongoing evolution.
* Experience working directly with engineering teams in an Agile/Scrum software development environment, including backlog management, story refinement and acceptance criteria.
* Strong technical aptitude and the ability to understand how APIs, backend services, platform capabilities and frontend experiences work together.
* Experience engaging directly with customers or partners to understand needs, define requirements and translate them into scalable product capabilities.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess competing requirements and make informed prioritization decisions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex product and technical concepts to both technical and business audiences.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple initiatives and customer priorities simultaneously in a global environment.

We will give careful consideration to your application and review your details against the position criteria. You will receive separate notification as your application progresses.

Please note that only candidates who meet the minimum criteria for the role will proceed in the selection process.

* Experience with CMS, Digital Experience Platforms, or Martech

* Strong understanding of APIs and modern web architectures

* AI-native CMS innovation

* SEO/GEO-first digital experiences

* Enterprise content scalability

1. Product Strategy & Roadmapping
  
2. Enterprise SaaS Product Management
  
3. AI-first Product Thinking

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field

**What We Offer**

* Competitive compensation and incentives

* Opportunity to build AI-first products

* Exposure to global enterprise customers

* Career growth and leadership opportunities

* Collaborative and innovative culture

Interested candidates are invited to submit their resume and a cover letter outlining their qualifications and vision for the role plus previous experience align with key attributes, responsibilities, clear wins or learnings.

  

**Why Milestone**

* AI-first Digital Experience Platform

* SEO/GEO-native CMS leadership

* Founder-led innovation culture

title: Senior AI Product Manager
job_description:
**Job Purpose:**

As a Senior AI Product Manager, you will be the day-to-day strategic partner for forward deployed engineering (FDE) pods working on a set of high-impact engagements. This is an individual contributor role for someone who can take a complex business problem, structure it, size the value, prototype hands-on, and turn it into something a forward deployed engineer can build against.

You won’t manage engineers — you will be in the room with them, the business sponsor, and the data, translating between all three and keeping each engagement focused on the most valuable outcome.

Forward deployed teams are most powerful when paired with sharp opportunity selection. In this role, you will make sure the engineers we deploy are working on the right things by:

* Sizing value, structuring problems, building concept prototypes, and writing the business cases that fund engagements.
* Acting as the day-to-day strategic counterpart to FDE pods in active deployments.
* Bringing opportunity signals from business sponsors back into the portfolio.

**Responsibilities:**

  

**Opportunity identification and value sizing**

* Surface and size AI opportunities across your assigned engagements and adjacent business units, producing one-page opportunity briefs that are easy to compare and prioritise.
* Build credible value cases with finance-grade reasoning behind cycle time saved, decisions accelerated, revenue uplift, or cost avoided.
* Develop hands-on domain knowledge of your engagement areas — workflows, data, decisions, and the people who own them.

**Strategic prioritisation and portfolio shaping**

* Recommend what to start, continue, and stop across your engagements based on evidence, not enthusiasm.
* Sequence work for impact, helping engineering leads decide what is in scope this sprint, what comes next, and what is out.

**Engineering partnership and enablement**

* Be the day-to-day strategic partner to FDE pods, converting business ambiguity into crisp problem statements, success metrics, and decision frameworks engineers can act on.
* Run engagement structure end-to-end — scope, success criteria, exit conditions, and scaling pathways — drafted, agreed, and revisited.
* Spot reusable patterns that should become platform capabilities instead of point solutions.

**Stakeholder alignment and communication**

* Work confidently with Director-level business and scientific stakeholders, running working sessions that move things forward and produce decisions, not just notes.
* Maintain sponsor confidence with concise updates, honest risk calls, and clear asks.

**Measurement, learning, and iteration**

* Track value realisation on each engagement against the business case written up front.
* Capture lessons rigorously and feed them back into how the team scopes the next engagement.

**Required Skills:**

* 15+ years of professional experience with bachelor’s or master’s degree or equivalent qualification.
* Candidates with the combination of pharma/life sciences, AI/ML products, product management, or strategy roles in technology-led organisations are preferred.
* A track record of taking complex, ambiguous business problems and turning them into structured, sized opportunities with defensible business cases.
* Strong working knowledge of at least one area of the pharma value chain (such as R&D, supply chain, or commercial), including how decisions actually get made on the ground.
* Technical fluency in modern AI/ML — enough to design realistic engagements with engineers and avoid hype-driven choices.
* Strong individual contributor instincts — you produce quality artefacts, not status updates.

**Preferred Skills**:

  

* Experience in Global Supply Chain (GSC), particularly Quality and Manufacturing Science & Technology (MSAT).
* Working knowledge of large language models (LLMs), agentic systems, the ML lifecycle, and evaluation patterns, with the ability to assess data readiness (availability, quality, access constraints, and labelling) before engineering starts.
* Understanding of how GxP, regulatory, and data-governance requirements shape AI deployments in pharma — and how to factor them into scoping without over-constraining engineering.
* Experience producing value cases with clear assumptions and sensitivity ranges, and maintaining an opportunity portfolio with clear rationale for what is in flight, queued, or de-prioritised.
* Product intuition: a clear understanding of the difference between an MVP, a product, and a platform, and the ability to spot patterns that should become shared capabilities.
* An AI-native way of working — codifying product management and user research best practices into reusable skills, plugins, and markdown files, and using the command line to automate everyday tasks.
* Ability to lead through influence and write crisp, outcome-focused communications that connect progress to the value case.
* Experience running honest retrospectives that distinguish execution failures from selection failures.

**Skills**

Agentic Platforms, Global Supply Chain, Global Supply Chain Strategy, Pharmaceutical Supply Chain, User Needs Analysis

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

job_description:
##### **Project description**

We are looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to lead complex digital capabilities across KYC/AML and Client Lifecycle Management (CLM). You will work at the intersection of business stakeholders, Vendor teams, Architects and Engineers, driving the product development journey from discovery to delivery through continuous improvement.
  
  
This is a hands-on Individual Contributor role for someone comfortable moving between stakeholder workshops, process design, wireframes, API specifications, user stories, and Agile engineering delivery.

##### **Responsibilities**

Own product capabilities end-to-end from discovery, strategy and roadmap through delivery, adoption and optimisation.

Translate complex KYC/AML and business problems into epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria and measurable outcomes.

Build and prioritise the product backlog, balancing business value, regulatory needs, technology dependencies and technical debt.

Lead discovery workshops and create process flows, client/user journeys, wireframes and UI mock-ups.

Partner closely with Engineering, Architecture, Operations, Product lead and business stakeholders.

Define requirements for REST APIs, including request/response behavior, JSON structures, data mapping, validation, errors and integration scenarios.

Drive Agile delivery through refinement, sprint planning, reviews and release planning.

Define appropriate non-functional requirements, including performance, availability, security, auditability, volumes and exception handling.

Use data and basic SQL to investigate issues, validate requirements and support product decisions.

Identify opportunities for automation, AI and Copilot to improve product delivery and operational efficiency.

##### **Skills**

Must have

At least 10 years of relevant experience, including strong hands-on Product Management/Product Ownership experience in complex enterprise environments.

Strong understanding of KYC/AML, Client Lifecycle Management, client onboarding, and periodic/event-driven KYC.

Proven experience delivering products using Agile/Scrum ways of working.

Excellent requirements, business-analysis and problem-solving skills.

Strong experience creating wireframes, UI mock-ups, user journeys, and process flows.

Good technical understanding of REST APIs, JSON and Swagger/OpenAPI specifications.

Working knowledge of SQL to perform data analysis.

Basic understanding of Azure/cloud, microservices, API gateways and event-driven integration concepts.

Excellent written and verbal communication with the ability to bridge business and technology.

Confident working independently, influencing without authority and constructively challenging assumptions.

Proactive, positive and ownership-driven attitude, comfortable operating in ambiguity.

Effective use of Microsoft Copilot for requirements elicitation, documentation and productivity improvement.

Nice to have

Intelligent Document Processing, document management platform.

Experience with KYC/AML, handling external data providers.

Knowledge of Kafka/webhooks, asynchronous processing, Postman, GitLab/Jira/Confluence, data lineage and observability.

Experience with legal-entity/reference data, company registries, data reconciliation and multi-jurisdiction regulatory requirements.

##### **Other**

Languages

English: B2 Upper Intermediate

Seniority

Senior

  

Pune, India

title: Senior Product Manager I
job_description:
About Us:

Seismic is the Go-To-Market Performance company, driving how organizations turn their strategy into revenue. Seismic brings together signals from customer conversations, buyer engagement, governed content, coaching and seller behavior to turn intelligence into winning action. Through its AI revenue execution platform, the company equips customer-facing teams with the insights, governance, and contextual guidance they need to execute with confidence and deliver measurable business outcomes. Trusted by 2,500 organizations and over 3.5 million users around the globe, Seismic is headquartered in San Diego with offices across North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. Learn more at seismic.com.

Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here.

Overview:

Learning is where that mission gets personal. Our vision is Connected Learning: training, practice, and coaching that are always-on and tailored to each rep, grounded in what's actually happening in their deals. Because learning shares context with a rep's accounts, meetings, approved content, and skills, we can deliver what they need next, in the moment they need it, and show whether it moved the number.

As a Senior Product Manager, you'll lead key parts of two of our strategic themes: Adaptive Training, which removes the manual work for enablement teams and gives every rep only what they still need, and Continuous Learning, which brings learning into the flow of work so it sticks. You'll partner closely with others PMs on the team.

At Seismic, PMs operate as the general managers of their areas. You won't be handed a backlog of feature requests. You'll decide where the most valuable, durable opportunities are, place the bets, and own the results: adoption, expansion, retention, and revenue. This is a role for a PM who wants to run a business, not maintain a feature list.

Who you are::

* **5+ years of product management experience** building user-facing products (B2B or B2C). You're fluent in discovery, specs, prioritization, and launch, and you don't need training on the fundamentals.
* **An AI-forward way of working**. You use AI every day to work faster and better, whether that's synthesizing research, prototyping, drafting specs, or analyzing data, and you can share specific recent examples.
* **A business owner's mindset**. You think in terms of outcomes, unit economics, and durable value, define clear success metrics, read the data, and change course when the evidence says so.
* **Technical fluency**. You can have credible conversations with engineers about LLMs, agent harness, data, and design tradeoffs.
* **A strong point of view**, held with humility. You can turn ambiguity into a clear plan and bring engineering, design, marketing, sales, and customer success along with you.
* Comfort working with distributed teams across time zones, including occasional early or late meetings.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

**Bonus points**

* You've shipped AI products, such as agents, copilots, or AI-powered features, and know what it takes to make them reliable.
* You've built learning products, in corporate learning, sales enablement and readiness, edtech, or consumer learning.
* You're curious about how people learn: spaced reinforcement, mastery learning, coaching, and practice.
* A category being rewritten. AI is changing how sellers learn and how enablement teams work, and you'll help define what comes next.
* Ownership that's real. You'll run a meaningful area of the business, with the accountability and the room to match.
* Real scale from day one. Your work will reach enablement teams and sellers at some of the world's best-known brands.
* A team that builds with AI, not just for it. We use agentic tools in our own work and expect you to as well.

What you'll be doing::

* Run your areas like a business. Set the strategy and roadmap, choose the bets that create the most durable value, help shape how they're packaged and priced, and own the adoption, retention, and revenue outcomes that follow.
* Create best-in-class agentic training authoring and training management, so enablement teams turn the content they already trust into training in minutes and agents handle the busywork of assigning, tracking, and following up, whether teams work in Seismic or in the AI tools they already use.
* Make training adapt to every rep, so reps skip what they've already mastered and spend their time on what they still need.
* Bring learning into the flow of work with just-in-time micro-learning, instant answers grounded in training, and peer examples from top performers' real calls.
* Connect learning to performance. Use deal, meeting, and skill signals to decide what each rep needs next, and define how we prove impact beyond course completions.
* Stay close to customers. Talk with enablement leaders, sellers, and managers every week, run discovery with design and research, and bring a sharp point of view back to the team.
* Ship with engineering in fast, measurable increments, including the evals and quality bar that make AI features trustworthy.

Job Posting Footer:

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Please be aware we have noticed an increase in hiring scams potentially targeting Seismic candidates. Read our full statement on our Careers page.
