title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
**Company Description**

Organizations everywhere struggle under the crushing costs and complexities of “solutions” that promise to simplify their lives. To create a better experience for their customers and employees. To help them grow. Software is a choice that can make or break a business. Create better or worse experiences. Propel or throttle growth. Business software has become a blocker instead of ways to get work done.

**There’s another option. Freshworks. With a fresh vision for how the world works.**

Freshworks Inc. builds uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional employee and customer experiences. Our people-first approach to AI eliminates friction, helping businesses reduce complexity, lower cost-to-serve, and deliver faster, more human support through enterprise-grade yet easy-to-use CX and IT solutions. Nearly 75,000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks to power their Employee Experience (EX) and Customer Experience (CX) operations.

***Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.***

 **Job Description**

Take Ownership: Own and build modules for sustained differentiation and growth. Develop deep domain expertise and understand trends in the market. The role requires you to plan, build, release, and measure success for an end to end modules.

Be a Customer Champion: Develop a sense of empathy with our customer base to build an understanding of various problems. The role is also a bridge between the customer and the engineering teams to ensure focus on solving customer needs & delivering continuous value. Practice Craftsmanship: Learn and Practice product craft. Create solutions with delightful user experiences and find the balance between solving the customer problem and shipping the right product solution. We take pride in releasing the smallest of features while iterating and shipping regularly.

Play as One Team: The role needs you to communicate clearly to various stakeholders of Product development, Engineering, Marketing, Sales & Leadership teams and work together to bring your vision to life.

Act with Urgency: Breakdown complex problems to phases to help the team make incremental progress while still keeping the bigger picture intact. You’d evangelize the vision and ensure maximum customer value is achieved with the appropriate amount of work.

 **Qualifications**

* 8+ years of working in global/cross-functional software teams in a software product company. SaaS experience is preferred as you’d settle right in.
* Experience in building SaaS products is a plus
* Being empathetic and having a strong listening ability to understand the other person - may it be a customer or a stakeholder.
* Ability to arrive at intuitive & uncomplicated solutions from concept to scale by leveraging AI.
* Ability to communicate complex concepts/customer problems in a simple way to internal & external stakeholders.
* A track record of making day-to-day data-driven decisions in a fast-evolving environment while keeping an eye on the overall vision.
* Having worked in a mode of structured experimentation - measuring and iterating on problems from time to time to achieve product goals.

 **Additional Information**

At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business. **Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

author: Hiring Manager
title: Sr Staff Technical Product Manager
job_description:
The Analytics & AI Delivery Manager for Sourcing is responsible for defining, owning, and executing the end-to-end data, analytics, and AI product delivery for Power’s Sourcing organization. This leadership role ensures that analytical and AI products are delivered on time, within budget, and to high-quality standards while generating measurable business value.
  
  
Serving as a strategic bridge across executive business stakeholders, Digital Technology, analytics operations, AI Foundry, Power teams, the leader will establish the product vision, define complex business and technical requirements, and translate business priorities into scalable, user-centric Analytics and AI solutions. The role will orchestrate cross-functional delivery, drive adoption and integration into day-to-day operations, and continuously improve product performance across the Sourcing domain.
  
  
As the AI Delivery Leader, this individual will oversee overall AI product delivery—from data readiness assessments and Proof-of-Concept execution through MVP delivery, production deployment, and operational transition. By combining deep business-process understanding with strategic roadmap ownership and disciplined delivery oversight, the leader will ensure that data and AI investments remain aligned with operational priorities, customer needs, and evolving market opportunities.

**Job Description**
===================

**Roles and Responsibilities**

In this role, you will:

* **AI Data Readiness and Delivery**: Partner with the AI Strategy Data Science and AI Architecture teams to lead data-readiness activities, technical execution of proofs of concept, MVP development, and the scaling of validated solutions into high-impact, production-grade AI products.

* **AI Strategy and Demand Management:** Partner with the AI Strategy Portfolio team to build and maintain a strong demand pipeline, establish effective intake and prioritization processes, and enable a stable, scalable AI delivery model.

* **Data and Analytics Strategy and Lifecycle Ownership**: Partner with Data Architects to define and execute the end-to-end roadmap for data, analytics, and AI products—from ideation and proof of concept through MVP delivery, production deployment, and ongoing product optimization.

* **Partner and Capacity Management:** Translate demand and priorities from the agile planning process into actionable capacity plans. Lead the Program Increment planning process and work with OCIO and strategic partners to onboard the right resources and capabilities for both analytics and AI delivery.

* **Cross-Functional Leadership**: Serve as the primary liaison among executive stakeholders, Digital Technology, business operations, and delivery partners to align requirements, priorities, and execution with strategic business objectives.

* **Operational Excellence:** Drive simplification, standardization, and delivery rigor by facilitating workshops and implementing improvements across tools, processes, and workflows.

* **Requirements and Backlog Management**: Translate complex business needs into well-defined features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and prioritized product backlogs using agile or hybrid delivery methodologies.

* **Data, Risk, and Compliance Governance**: Ensure that all analytics and AI solutions comply with enterprise standards for data quality, architecture, cybersecurity, internal controls, privacy, and regulatory requirements.

* **Standard Work and Platform Optimization**: Establish robust standard work, simplify complex delivery processes, and continuously optimize analytical platforms and operating models for scalability, reliability, and performance.

* **Performance Monitoring and Value Realization**: Define product KPIs, monitor adoption and user feedback, identify performance trends, and drive continuous product enhancements that deliver measurable business outcomes.

* **Automation and Productivity**: Identify opportunities to automate manual activities, improve end-to-end process and data lineage, and partner with enterprise data organizations to increase delivery efficiency and overall team productivity.

  
  

**Qualification**

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, or a STEM-related field, including Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics.

Experience in data management, business intelligence, data analytics, or related discipline.

Technical experience, with demonstrated leadership across multiple functions and disciplines within a product or delivery organization.

Demonstrated success leading at least two significant transformation initiatives, including organizational change management and the delivery of measurable business outcomes.

  

**Desired Characteristics**

  

* **Technical Proficiency:** Demonstrated experience working in Agile and SAFe environments, with strong knowledge of enterprise data and analytics technologies such as Power BI, Tableau, SQL, SAP, Oracle, and Databricks. Familiarity with cloud, big data, and AI/ML technologies, including AWS, Python, Spark, and Java, is highly desirable.

* **Business and Domain Expertise:** Strong understanding of Sourcing value streams and the integration of transactional and analytical data to enable actionable insights and measurable business value.

* **AI and Analytics Strategy**: Solid knowledge of data governance, master data management, and the end-to-end AI and machine learning lifecycle, including data readiness, proof-of-concept execution, MVP development, production deployment, and ongoing optimization.

* **Strategic Leadership:** Proven ability to lead transformation, navigate competing priorities, influence senior stakeholders, and translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable insights for non-technical business leaders.

* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Demonstrated ability to build inclusive, high-performing teams and collaborate effectively across Digital Technology, Sourcing and other functional organizations to align product strategy with operational priorities.

* **Governance and Risk Management:** Strong commitment to enterprise standards and controls, including cybersecurity, SOX compliance, data governance, privacy, application controls, and regulatory requirements.

* **Process Improvement:** Experience applying Lean principles, structured problem-solving, and continuous-improvement methodologies to simplify processes, establish standard work, and improve the scalability and performance of the product portfolio.

* **Influential Communication:** Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to mentor and energize teams, establish a shared vision, build alignment, and maintain momentum through complex technical and organizational challenges.

**Additional Information**
==========================

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** No

title: Sr Product Manager
job_description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Overview:

Visa is seeking an experienced Product Manager to define and drive the strategy, roadmap, and adoption of enterprise Data Governance Platforms. This role will help shape how Visa discovers, understands, governs, measures, and trusts data across the enterprise through capabilities spanning metadata management, data quality, governance workflows, semantic capabilities, domain ownership, and related data governance technologies. The Product Manager will partner closely with Engineering, Architecture, Data Governance, Privacy, Security, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable platform capabilities that improve data trust, operational efficiency, regulatory compliance, and data-driven decision making.

Essential Functions:

* Define vision, strategy, roadmap, and success metrics for one or more enterprise data governance platforms.
* Align platform investments with enterprise data strategy, governance objectives, AI readiness, cloud transformation, and business priorities.
* Manage portfolio priorities, investment tradeoffs, and roadmap sequencing.
* Maintain and prioritize product backlogs, epics, features, and business requirements.
* Partner with engineering teams throughout the software delivery lifecycle.
* Define acceptance criteria and measurable business outcomes.
* Coordinate dependencies across multiple products, teams, and stakeholders.
* Conduct customer discovery and requirements gathering.
* Partner with governance, privacy, risk, architecture, and business teams to identify opportunities and pain points.
* Drive adoption through communication, enablement, onboarding, and feedback programs.
* Translate governance policies and business requirements into scalable platform capabilities.
* Support capabilities including metadata management, data quality, stewardship, governance workflows, access controls, certification, lineage, business definitions, semantic models, and trust indicators.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and identify opportunities for innovation.
* Partner with engineering and architecture teams to define integration strategies across cloud, on-premises, and SaaS environments.
* Collaborate with adjacent platforms supporting analytics, AI/ML, reporting, data engineering, governance, and operational workflows.
* Drive interoperability between governance platforms and enterprise data ecosystems.
* Evaluate commercial, cloud-native, and open-source technologies.
* Conduct product assessments and develop build-versus-buy recommendations.
* Stay current on trends in data governance, metadata management, data quality, AI governance, semantic technologies, and observability.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

Basic Qualifications:

* 8 or more years of relevant work experience with a bachelor’s degree or at least 5 years of experience with an advanced degree (e.g., Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 2 years of work experience with a PhD

Preferred Qualifications:

* 10 or more years of relevant work experience with a bachelor’s degree, or 7 or more years of experience with an advanced degree (e.g., Master's, MBA, JD, MD), or 3 or more years of experience with a PhD.
* 5+ years of experience in Product Management, Technical Product Management, Platform Product Management, or a related discipline supporting enterprise data, analytics, governance, or technology platforms.
* Experience defining product vision, strategy, roadmaps, and success metrics for enterprise platforms, with a demonstrated ability to balance customer needs, business priorities, and technical constraints.
* Experience working in one or more data management domains, including Data Governance, Metadata Management, Data Quality, Data Catalogs, Data Lineage, Data Stewardship, Master Data Management, Data Observability, Semantic Technologies, or related capabilities.
* Strong understanding of modern data ecosystems, including cloud platforms, data lakes, data warehouses, databases, APIs, data integration patterns, and distributed data architectures.
* Experience partnering closely with engineering, architecture, governance, security, compliance, privacy, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable enterprise solutions.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives, influence without authority, build alignment across diverse stakeholder groups, and drive outcomes in complex organizational environments.
* Experience with Agile product development methodologies, including roadmap planning, backlog management, requirements definition, prioritization, and release planning.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate tradeoffs, interpret data, identify opportunities, and make informed product decisions.
* Excellent verbal, written, and presentation communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with both technical teams and senior leadership.
* Experience evaluating vendor solutions, commercial software products, cloud-native capabilities, and emerging technologies, including development of build-versus-buy recommendations.
* Experience with cloud technologies, enterprise data platforms, databases, SQL, and data engineering concepts.
* Prior experience within financial services, banking, payments, regulated industries, or large enterprise environments is preferred.
* Advanced degrees desirable.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

**Ready to turn bold ideas into real-world impact?**  
At Genpact, we don’t just adapt to change, we lead it. AI and digital innovation are transforming the way businesses work, and we’re at the forefront of it. Genpact’s AI Gigafactory, our industry-first accelerator, exemplifies how we scale advanced technology solutions to help global enterprises work smarter, grow faster, and transform at scale. Whether tackling complex challenges through large-scale models or agentic AI, our breakthrough solutions tackle companies’ most complex challenges.  
  
If you thrive in a fast-moving, innovation-driven environment, love building and deploying cutting-edge AI solutions, and want to push the boundaries of what’s possible, this is your moment.

Bachelors - Computer Science, Bachelors - Economics, Bachelors - Information Technology, Bachelors - Marketing, Masters - Business Administration

Agentic AI, Agile Methodology, Change Management, Client Relations, Commercial Modeling, Design Thinking, Digital Business Strategy, Executive Presence, Inclusion, Modernizing Operations, People Leadership, Program Implementation, Storytelling

English

English (OVERALL - Advanced - C1)

Regular

Product Management

**Remote Type -**

Hybrid

Day Job (India)

* **Lead AI-powered transformation** – Drive innovation and solve real-world business challenges that matter
* **Make an impact** – Help global enterprises solve business challenges that matter
* **Accelerate your career** – Gain hands-on experience, mentorship, and world-class learning opportunities to stay ahead
* **Work with the best** – Join 140,000+ bold thinkers and problem-solvers who push boundaries every day
* **Thrive in a values-driven culture** – Our courage, curiosity, and incisiveness - built on a foundation of integrity and inclusion - allow your ideas to fuel progress

  
Come join the 140,000+ coders, tech shapers, and growth makers at Genpact and take your career in the only direction that matters: Up.  
Let’s build tomorrow together.  
  
Genpact is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for all positions without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, age, national origin, citizenship status, marital status, military/veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, physical or mental disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. Furthermore, please do note that Genpact does not charge fees to process job applications and applicants are not required to pay to participate in our hiring process in any other way. Examples of such scams include purchasing a 'starter kit,' paying to apply, or purchasing equipment or training.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Sr. Product Manager, Mobile
job_description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

  
  

Docusign brings agreements to life. More than 1.8 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using the Docusign AI-native IAM platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).

  
  

**What you'll do**
------------------

  
  

As the Sr. Product Manager for Mobile you will focus on delivering impactful innovations further accelerating the growth of Docusign's top-rated eSignature mobile apps, which is an important part of our millions of users' journey as we embrace the "anywhere economy". You will drive solutions that allow our customers to get to agreement anywhere on any device. You will work with cross-functional leaders to define a multi-year strategy and lead the efforts to build the roadmap, vision, and priorities for supporting this priority product area. You will deeply understand how Docusign can best deliver for our customers' needs and work with product development teams across Docusign to deliver product capabilities and solutions that support customers end-to-end agreement flows on mobile. Interacting directly with customers to validate needs will be a key part of your role.

Docusign has built award winning and the most pervasive technology for enabling businesses to automate their agreement processes - from generating agreements, negotiating between parties, getting agreements electronically signed, managing the workflows and integrations once an agreement is signed and analyzing and deriving insights from agreements. Today, Docusign's products meet the needs of customers extending from individual consumers to large Enterprises. You will serve as the subject matter expert guiding product development teams on what capabilities and solutions will best meet customers' mobile needs for their agreement challenges. Using qualitative and quantitative insights, you will deliver a strategy and product roadmap that both transforms how Docusign meets customer needs and drives measurable impact. In this position you will work cross-functionally with Design, Marketing, and Engineering and engage directly with customers to experiment and iterate.

This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the VP, Product Management.

**Responsibility**

* Prioritize opportunities and lead product strategy and roadmaps focused on customer and business impact
* Build roadmaps by synthesizing customer needs, user research, data science, market and competitive insights, marketing input, and field feedback
* Develop a deep understanding of target personas, workflows, pain points, and jobs to be done through customer engagement and lifecycle research-from awareness and evaluation through adoption, renewal, and expansion
* Review competitors, vendors, adjacent solutions, industry trends, and relevant market channels to anticipate customer needs and identify opportunities for differentiation
* Define product vision, requirements, and functional specifications; translate them into developer-ready epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria
* Prioritize and manage the feature backlog, dependencies, and tradeoffs to support effective release and sprint planning
* Lead and motivate a team of engineers and cross-functional representatives toward shared product outcomes
* Partner with Engineering, Design, User Experience, Research, and Program Management to take features from concept through launch while meeting quality, usability, performance, and reliability expectations
* Build business cases and gain stakeholder alignment for new capabilities, investments, and innovations
* Monitor, measure, and report on key business, product, and customer metrics; use telemetry, experimentation, and qualitative and quantitative feedback to drive continuous testing and optimization
* Identify and profile high-value use cases, partners, platforms, APIs, integrations, and ecosystem relationships that can expand product value and adoption
* Collaborate with Marketing, Pricing, Sales, Support, Legal, Security, Compliance, Finance, and Business Development on go-to-market execution, enablement, adoption, and ongoing product growth
* Ensure product decisions account for applicable privacy, security, accessibility, legal, regulatory, and industry requirements
  

  

**Job Designation**
-------------------

  
  

**Hybrid:** Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.

  
  

**What you bring**
------------------

  
  

**Basic**

* 8+ years of relevant experience and a bachelor's degree, or 6+ years of relevant experience and a master's degree
* Experience in product management supporting SaaS products or technology-enabled services
* Experience delivering native mobile apps for iOS or Android using iterative or Agile methodologies
* Experience with usability principles and practices, including early and rapid prototyping and usability testing
* Experience with tools such as Mixpanel, Optimizely, JIRA, or comparable analytics, experimentation, and Scrum tools
* Experience working with cross-functional teams and delivering products using iterative or Agile methodologies, such as Scrum
* Experience with enterprise technology ecosystems, platforms, APIs, integrations, and common customer workflows

  

**Preferred**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Information Systems, Business Systems, or a related engineering or technical discipline
* Experience taking a product or major feature from concept to launch and through ongoing adoption and optimization
* Application of qualitative and quantitative testing and analysis to feature development and product decisions
* Superior analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to connect strategy, customer needs, research, data, competitive intelligence, and industry trends
* Strong written, verbal, presentation, and executive communication skills
* Ability to influence others, build alignment, and deliver results in cross-functional and matrixed environments
* Success managing large-scale, new, existing, or legacy technology products across complex customer or business environments
* Proficiency in defining product success metrics, building dashboards or telemetry, and using data to evaluate product performance and guide prioritization
* Strong customer focus, including customer discovery, solution validation, and translation of insights into measurable improvements in customer outcomes
* Business case development and stakeholder buy-in for product investments, partnerships, and innovation
* Collaboration with partners and external stakeholders to scale product capabilities, integrations, or distribution
* Involvement in product launches, enablement, change management, and adoption across multiple customer segments or geographies
* Ability to work effectively with Engineering, User Experience, Research, Product, Program Management, Sales, Marketing, IT, Compliance, Security, Legal, Business Development, and Support
* Background in consulting, marketing, strategy, operations, or related disciplines involving risk management, privacy, information security, compliance, or regulatory controls
  

  

**Life at Docusign**
--------------------

  
  

**Working here**

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.

**Accommodation**

Docusign is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need such an accommodation, or a religious accommodation, during the application process, please contact us at accommodations@docusign.com.

If you experience any issues, concerns, or technical difficulties during the application process please get in touch with our Talent organization at taops@docusign.com for assistance.

**AI in Our Hiring Process**
  
At Docusign, we embrace technology to enhance efficiency and create a better candidate experience. We may record or transcribe interviews using enterprise AI tools to assist with meeting notes and interview documentation so our teams can stay fully engaged in the conversation. All hiring decisions remain 100% human-led. You have the right to opt out at any time by notifying your recruiter or interview team, with zero impact on your candidacy.
  
We encourage using AI tools to research and prepare beforehand. However, to ensure an authentic evaluation, live AI assistance or external recording bots during interviews are not permitted.

* Experience with enterprise technology ecosystems, platforms, APIs, integrations, and common customer workflows

  

**Preferred**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Information Systems, Business Systems, or a related engineering or technical discipline
* Experience taking a product or major feature from concept to launch and through ongoing adoption and optimization
* Application of qualitative and quantitative testing and analysis to feature development and product decisions
* Superior analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to connect strategy, customer needs, research, data, competitive intelligence, and industry trends
* Strong written, verbal, presentation, and executive communication skills
* Ability to influence others, build alignment, and deliver results in cross-functional and matrixed environments
* Success managing large-scale, new, existing, or legacy technology products across complex customer or business environments
* Proficiency in defining product success metrics, building dashboards or telemetry, and using data to evaluate product performance and guide prioritization
* Strong customer focus, including customer discovery, solution validation, and translation of insights into measurable improvements in customer outcomes
* Business case development and stakeholder buy-in for product investments, partnerships, and innovation
* Collaboration with partners and external stakeholders to scale product capabilities, integrations, or distribution
* Involvement in product launches, enablement, change management, and adoption across multiple customer segments or geographies
* Ability to work effectively with Engineering, User Experience, Research, Product, Program Management, Sales, Marketing, IT, Compliance, Security, Legal, Business Development, and Support
* Background in consulting, marketing, strategy, operations, or related disciplines involving risk management, privacy, information security, compliance, or regulatory controls
  

  

**Life at Docusign**
--------------------

  
  

**Working here**

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.

**Accommodation**

Docusign is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need such an accommodation, or a religious accommodation, during the application process, please contact us at accommodations@docusign.com.

If you experience any issues, concerns, or technical difficulties during the application process please get in touch with our Talent organization at taops@docusign.com for assistance.

**AI in Our Hiring Process**
  
At Docusign, we embrace technology to enhance efficiency and create a better candidate experience. We may record or transcribe interviews using enterprise AI tools to assist with meeting notes and interview documentation so our teams can stay fully engaged in the conversation. All hiring decisions remain 100% human-led. You have the right to opt out at any time by notifying your recruiter or interview team, with zero impact on your candidacy.
  
We encourage using AI tools to research and prepare beforehand. However, to ensure an authentic evaluation, live AI assistance or external recording bots during interviews are not permitted.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager II
job_description:
Responsibilities:

Are you prepared to advance your career? Join Principal as a Product Manager II and play a key role in delivering valuable and viable solutions alongside our product team. In this role, you will manage products with medium complexity and sensitivity while ensuring alignment with product strategy and enterprise goals.

At Principal, we believe diverse perspectives drive better outcomes. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where people can bring their authentic selves to work, collaborate openly, and grow their careers. We value innovation, continuous learning, and a customer-first mindset, and we empower our employees to make meaningful contributions every day.

This opportunity allows you to demonstrate curiosity, flexibility, and motivation while gaining experience across every phase of the product lifecycle. We are excited to welcome a product leader who is passionate about solving customer problems and delivering value. Join us and make a meaningful impact!

**What You'll Do**

As a Product Manager II, you will establish and guide product strategy for products of low to medium complexity, working closely with senior product managers and directors to align solutions with broader business and enterprise objectives. You will incorporate business, customer, user, and partner insights to develop a clear understanding of problems, opportunities, and risks.

You will lead product discovery efforts by defining desired business outcomes, identifying opportunities for innovation, validating hypotheses, and partnering with cross-functional teams to conduct experiments. By evaluating results and extracting meaningful insights, you will help shape future product decisions and continuously improve how products are delivered.

Working closely with technology and business partners, you will drive product delivery by breaking down work into manageable increments that enable frequent releases of value. You will serve as the Product Owner for Scrum teams, support agile ceremonies, manage product roadmaps, and communicate release plans and priorities across stakeholder groups.

In addition, you will monitor product health, measure business impact, and leverage data to assess performance and guide strategic decisions. You'll collaborate with leaders across the business, including finance and go-to-market teams, to ensure alignment, readiness, and successful execution of product initiatives.

**Product Leadership**

You will serve as a mentor and resource for Associate Product Managers, helping strengthen product management practices and fostering a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement. You may also take formal leadership responsibility for the development of reporting Product Managers.

**Skills & Capabilities**

* Business insight, including industry expertise and financial management skills.
* Strong customer understanding and experience leveraging customer development practices.
* Comprehensive understanding of technology's role in solving business challenges.
* Excellent communication, influence, and negotiation skills.
* Strong analytical and conceptual problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to mentor, motivate, and collaborate across teams.
* Data-driven approach to prioritization and value creation.
* Ownership mindset with accountability for outcomes and a willingness to embrace change.

  
Qualifications:

**Qualifications**

* 10+ years of business, technology, or product management experience, or equivalent demonstrated through work experience, military experience, or education.
* Retirement Services domain knowledge and experience are preferred.
* 5+ years working in a highly collaborative, fast-paced environment with product or engineering teams and stakeholders.
* Bringing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree - B.E. / B.Tech / M.S. / M.Tech / MCA degree in Computer Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics or a related subject area

* Demonstrated experience managing one or more products.
* Proven critical thinking, collaboration, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and workloads effectively.
* Experience building and maintaining strong stakeholder relationships.
* Demonstrated ability to influence, persuade, and negotiate in a product environment.
* Experience leveraging customer, user, partner, and market insights to drive product decisions.

  
Additional Information:

Inclusion & Accessibility

Principal is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible experience for all applicants. Reasonable accommodations are available throughout the recruitment process for individuals with disabilities and for candidates who may require assistance to participate fully. If you need an accommodation, please let us know, and we will work with you to meet your needs.

Why Join Principal?

Be part of a world-class team where your ideas matter, your contributions are recognized, and your career can thrive. We are excited about the future and the impact our Product Managers make every day. If you're ready to help shape innovative solutions and drive meaningful outcomes, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today!

author: Hiring Manager
title: Associate Product Manager
job_description:
**Why Work Here**

* Headquarters is in Charlotte, NC
* Recently expanded to nearshore,Hyderabad
* isolved ranked for SMB Payroll in 2023 Sapient Report
* Voted top places to work in USA 2023

**Job Description**

Associate Product Manager, Suite Experience

**Summary/objective**

isolved is modernizing the user experience across its HCM platform, built on a shared design system. In this role you will work from our Hyderabad office as the day-to-day product owner for three development teams, each building new pages and experiences for a different product area at the same time.

The design system is already in place, so the job is less about designing from scratch and more about building the right thing correctly. You will make sure each new page does everything the current one does, works for every user role, and handles real-world edge cases. You will also answer the many small product and UX questions that come up during development. You will work closely with US-based product leadership, and the role requires regular overlap with US business hours for handoffs, planning, and decisions.

**Core Job Duties**

* Document how current pages work, including fields, actions, user permissions, and edge cases, so nothing is lost when they are rebuilt
* Own backlog refinement and sprint readiness for three development teams working in parallel
* Write user stories and acceptance criteria that cover page behavior, validation, error and empty states, role-based access, and accessibility

title: Associate Product Manager
job_description:
We are looking for a highly motivated Associate Product Manager (APM) with 1–3 years of experience in building and managing websites and mobile applications. The ideal candidate will support the end-to-end product lifecycle from requirement gathering to launch, while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams including engineering, design, business, QA, and account management.

You will play a key role in improving user experience, driving feature adoption, and ensuring timely and high-quality product delivery. A keen eye for detail, user empathy, and a strong grasp of digital platforms are essential.

**Responsibilities:**

● Support the product roadmap and backlog for web and mobile platforms  
● Translate user needs and business goals into clear feature requirements and user stories ● Work with design and development teams to ensure timely and high-quality execution  
● Conduct user research, usability testing, and competitor benchmarking  
● Monitor product performance and user behavior using Google Analytics  
● Maintain clear product documentation, release notes, and training materials  
● Ensure alignment with business stakeholders and account managers, and provide regular updates on progress

**Required Skills and Traits:**

● Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Design, or a related field  
● 1–3 years of product experience in web and mobile app environments  
● Strong analytical skills and understanding of product metrics using Google Analytics  
● Experience with Zoho Sprints and familiarity with tools like JIRA, Figma, or Trello  
● Knowledge of project management and the complete product development lifecycle  
● Ability to lead ideation sessions and define clear user and business requirements  
● Good written and verbal communication skills  
● Experience working with cross-functional teams and client stakeholders  
● Strong presentation skills and the ability to deliver product demos with clear understanding of functionality and user workflows

**Preferred Qualifications:**

● Prior involvement in consumer-facing digital platforms  
● Understanding of APIs, technical constraints, and platform differences  
● Experience working with cloud-based products or services is a plus  
● Certification in Product Management from recognized institutions (e.g., Airtribe, Product School, Hello PM or equivalent)

Pay: ₹600,000.00 - ₹800,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* What is your total experience in product maagement (except freelancing/part time roles) ?
* Are you currently residing or willing to relocate to Goa ?
* Are willing to work 6 days a week onsite (Goa) ?
* Please mention your current/last fixed CTC (in lacs per annum).
* Please mention your expected CTC (in lacs per annum).
* How soon can you join (please include your notice period and relocation time needed for joining) ?

Work Location: In person

author: Hiring Manager
role: Finance Data Product Lead – Data & Analytics
role_title: Finance Data Product Lead – Data & Analytics
title: Finance Data Product Lead – Data & Analytics
job_description:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team.

**About Broadridge:**
---------------------

Broadridge Financial Solutions is a global fintech leader providing technology, communications and data-driven solutions that power the financial services industry. We help businesses improve operational efficiency, enhance client experiences and make better decisions through innovative technology and data solutions.

At Broadridge, we believe our people are at the heart of our success. We foster a culture built around collaboration, innovation, accountability and continuous learning, where employees have the opportunity to work on meaningful, business-critical solutions and build long-term careers.

**Job Summary**
---------------

The **Finance Data Product Lead – Data & Analytics** owns the design and support of data products, interfaces and processes in the Finance data ecosystem, spanning upstream systems (ERP and homegrown), the enterprise data platform, and consuming application integration.

This role is accountable for defining, supporting and governing scalable data products and processes, ensuring data integrity and reliability at enterprise scale, and acting as a trusted speaking partner to IT, Finance, and external service providers.

The role also focuses on monitoring, issue resolution, process standardization, data governance, and stakeholder communication, while guiding Level 1 resources and working closely with Level 2/3 IT support teams to drive long-term stability and continuous improvement.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Lead product discovery by gathering requirements from stakeholders, users, and technical teams.
* Design, implement, and govern data quality controls, reconciliation frameworks, and exception management mechanisms.
* Define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for data products aligned with business goals.
* Translate business needs into clear product requirements, user stories, and delivery plans.
* Prioritize initiatives based on business value, technical feasibility, user needs, and strategic fit.
* Identify high-impact opportunities where data products can improve decision-making, operations, or customer experience.
* Partner with data engineers, analysts, and business leaders to deliver data products.
* Drive implementation of data products in data platforms, dashboards, semantic layers, self-service analytics tools, APIs, and ML-enabled solutions.
* Establish KPIs and success metrics to measure adoption, usability, data quality, and business impact.
* Champion data quality, governance, documentation, and trust across products.
* Ensure data products are intuitive, accessible, and fit for purpose for target users.
* Manage stakeholder communication, expectations, timelines and risks.
* Continuously improve products through feedback, usage insights, and performance measurement.
* Support data ownership, governance frameworks, privacy, and compliance requirements where applicable.

**Qualifications & Skills**
---------------------------

* 7–10+ years of experience in data product management, data, analytics, or platform delivery.
* Extensive hands-on and architectural experience managing enterprise-scale data platforms handling high-volume, business-critical Finance data.
* Strong understanding of data architecture, analytics workflows, and reporting ecosystems.
* Ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams.
* Strong prioritization, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Familiarity with data governance, metrics design, and data quality principles.
* Experience delivering internal or external data-driven products.
* Advanced proficiency in **SQL and Snowflake**, including performance tuning, complex validations, reconciliation logic, and troubleshooting.
* Strong experience with data warehousing, ETL frameworks, and cloud data platforms.
* Preferred understanding of enterprise Finance systems and ERP platforms such as **Oracle (EBS / Fusion)** and **SAP (ECC / S/4HANA)**.
* Proven experience working with workload scheduling and automation tools such as **Apache Airflow and Control-M**.
* Solid understanding of data governance, data quality, controls, and reconciliation frameworks in Finance environments.
* Demonstrated experience acting as a stakeholder-facing lead, managing cross-functional dependencies across Finance, IT, and external vendors.
* Strong ability to translate Finance business logic into data rules, controls, and permanent technical solutions.
* Excellent communication, documentation, and executive-level articulation skills.
* Proven track record of driving complex issues to resolution across multiple teams and vendors.

**Why Join Broadridge?**
------------------------

* **Work on meaningful, business-critical solutions:** Contribute to Finance data products and platforms that support enterprise-scale financial operations.
* **Be at the intersection of Finance, Data & Technology:** Work across Finance, IT, data engineering, analytics and business teams.
* **Drive transformation:** Play a key role in improving data quality, governance, automation and decision-making.
* **Collaborative environment:** Partner with diverse teams and senior stakeholders across the organization.
* **Growth & learning:** Build expertise across data products, cloud platforms, Finance systems, analytics and emerging technologies.
* **Global exposure:** Work with teams, stakeholders and technology ecosystems supporting Broadridge's global business.
* **Innovation-driven culture:** Be part of an organization that continuously invests in technology, data and better ways of working.

**Join Us**
-----------

If you are a data and technology professional who understands Finance data, enjoys solving complex business problems, and can bridge the gap between Finance, Data and IT, we would love to hear from you.

**Join Broadridge and help shape the future of Finance Data Products.**

We are dedicated to fostering a collaborative, engaging, and inclusive environment and are committed to providing a workplace that empowers associates to be authentic and bring their best to work. We believe that associates do their best when they feel safe, understood, and valued, and we work diligently and collaboratively to ensure Broadridge is a company—and ultimately a community—that recognizes and celebrates everyone’s unique perspective.

**Use of AI in Hiring**

As part of the recruiting process, Broadridge may use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI)-based tools, to help review and evaluate applications. These tools are used only to support our recruiters and hiring managers, and all employment decisions include human review to ensure fairness, accuracy, and compliance with applicable laws. Please note that honesty and transparency are critical to our hiring process. Any attempt to falsify, misrepresent, or disguise information in an application, resume, assessment, or interview will result in disqualification from consideration.
